subject: We’re being outspent

body:
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=826%2E127862%2E9vXmJf)
Folks, there’s no other way to say it: **We’re being outspent 168 to 1.**
That’s a serious gap, and if we don’t work together to close it ASAP, undecided voters may not hear from us before they go to cast their ballot.
**[This is a make-or-break moment for our campaign. Please, rush a donation of $5 or any amount to help us catch up before it’s too late.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260903_2_ak.vwdqZl&amount=5&refcode=em20260903-818&t=3&akid=826%2E127862%2E9vXmJf)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260903_2_ak.vwdqZl&amount=5&refcode=em20260903-818&t=4&akid=826%2E127862%2E9vXmJf)**
Unlike Lombardo, I don’t have a Rolodex of billionaire donors I can call and ask for a favor. I have you and other members of our grassroots team to count on.
I wouldn’t have it any other way, but that doesn’t change the fact that our fundraising pace isn’t where it should be.
This race is a total toss-up. Election forecasters say it, and I can feel it on the ground. **Truly, the factor that will matter most in determining who wins this is who can break through the noise and get their message across to as many Nevadans as possible.**
That requires ample resources, and right now, Lombardo is outmatching us.
We still have time to bounce back, but that window is closing quickly. **[Help us get back in the fight by chipping in $5 or whatever you can afford today:](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260903_2_ak.vwdqZl&amount=5&refcode=em20260903-818&t=5&akid=826%2E127862%2E9vXmJf)**

Thanks so much,
Aaron

Hey friend,
Here’s the math:
Lombardo has received more than **$2 million** in campaign donations from data center interests.
Meanwhile his administration doled out more than **$240 million** in tax breaks to big data center companies.

Dear Fellow Americans,
The alarming rise of antisemitism in Canada should concern every American.
Thanks for reading The Goldstein Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..gWxR640bPG2B1qTn1gL5uothw9dq2Vsvsu9-bjg9ep8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=214090045)
Although Jews represent only about one percent of Canada's population, they have been disproportionately targeted by reported hate crimes. Jewish schools have been fired upon. Synagogues have faced arson and firebombing attacks. Jewish institutions and businesses have been targeted, and Jewish students have faced intimidation on university campuses.
For Jewish families, these are not simply statistics. They are warnings.
The National Association of Christian Lawmakers (NACL), representing American lawmakers from across the country, has written to President Donald J. Trump asking his administration to help Canadian Jews facing religious persecution seek refuge in the United States.
**As a Jewish American, I joined NACL as a Friend because I saw Christian lawmakers willing to step forward, speak out, and stand with the Jewish people when too many others remained silent. Today, they are speaking up for Jews facing persecution in Canada --and President Trump is listening.**
NACL has consistently condemned antisemitism and declared that this moral evil must be confronted wherever it appears. Its letter warns that since October 7, 2023, Jewish schools, synagogues, institutions, businesses, and families across Canada have faced an alarming climate of harassment, intimidation, vandalism, threats, and violence.
Tulsa, Oklahoma, with support from Governor Kevin Stitt, has sent a different message: Jewish families seeking safety and freedom are welcome.
But Americans cannot pretend this is only Canada's problem.
We are witnessing antisemitism here as well--from extremists on college campuses, in our streets, and increasingly in our political discourse. Whether it comes from the radical left, radical Islamism, white supremacy, or anywhere else, antisemitism must be confronted.
History has taught us a painful lesson: **antisemitism starts with the Jews, but it never ends there.**
Jews have too often been the canary in the coal mine when societies begin abandoning religious liberty, democratic institutions, individual rights, and the rule of law. Once hatred and political intimidation become acceptable against one group, the freedoms of everyone are endangered.
That is why what is happening in Canada should be a warning to America.
I am running for Congress because I believe in the Constitution of the United States, religious liberty, representative government, economic opportunity, and individual freedom. I will fight antisemitism and religious persecution, and I will oppose political extremism and socialism that threaten the principles that have made America free and prosperous.
Freedom does not preserve itself.
Every American who believes in religious liberty should stand with the Jewish people against antisemitism. Every American who believes in democracy should defend our Constitution. Every American who believes in freedom should be prepared to defend it.
**Antisemitism starts with the Jews. It never ends there.**
Let us stand against hatred, stand for freedom, and preserve America for the generations that follow.
**Dr. Michael Goldstein**
Candidate for United States Congress
Connecticut's Fourth Congressional District

I looked at the numbers. Your file is empty. Let's fix that right now. |
Patriot,

I have spent thirty years reading voter data. I know what a healthy file looks like -- and _I know what a gap looks like._

**_Right now, your file has a gap._**

**_[The 2026 Republican Policy Assessment is still sitting incomplete — and that is the one thing I need you to fix before tonight.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=90c31954354348aeb42401052aee4382&_e=SrBqW1q7d6UPZ6ocTutm5j-_nrRVwqh-JLS7CU70zb-rRPPqyJK8_tkZJJx0t_eCpXGYN6oYuxHM03bpOxNb8wOqoo4NO8d7TrS599jKzZ5AjCgxOii0IiFTWQlpYPHxW2_LZkKOii_Y44XEwdT7lPDGsge7pNpFwyWIXVT3vOs_8OQAti-coaKTBp40pzLhNx-aFZBPpACXMgnqAxSYjNVxebt18nCm-KmXeO5PGDTfn4ya-wVEAhULfh4y_IgurMhxLjPvy-ssaH9N2lOn2GYnnavMAmGsLjlfvOq4rITl_gBOqGid0zgAheg7VZaW69TjjbKG470r8W0RU1KHmImZX43u9DjQ1U1YZ1BeoEAZK-EKUVvk9sjax_o4Y84H17UF_ZZ61WFZMzK9mupLxoSFqWd8-la289BIPD43CboqOAbAo1ha1gL_tbjRGxI2b6wA_uh9q0YNeRSuSK9v6kZFb2aS2m7aUXnGYK-k6H0Hb-HgIaVquDLcs-kglWE5vfwcbHIGhxs0CJaGyEfkRZOon6hv1i9pGOvrWWO-vDunksvqaoqoComlV-cXENqVk0hb16d39JcRbFJkvfTCoIRUffvx1l7qyiR8yVYxOcVf_jCrfiiXWnyp8_ie1SMeQBtO6soSfvvJ3JDp3ySm1FGJrKddfJaeVxOY9raBxIgAhR9DkTujp7wqNzMRGWHOyaW5c9_WLU1mNYCv2v336oLabHwZPWpu1-IQxOmEy3ExosY2Bqb1ZFBvHkXg9c6Utjpr7Lnoba27tFBTHyb55QzI0KgIA_eMHJqc41mZp5Hm5MxHF7BqL0804OFNMd2mtUWAAlm4bO9Ay__t9msQh9cIyK6NBh-pIIXjKVOpiU-NTMNchGZprMnI1ChjthXUPys1jgI1JTUa2GGnRW0xBLO07WAqcQ4NqD-A4Dkb6zA1Qwmqw2gr6AlkA0zkgoquzJA2wQqXonbU-rH7Aycdr__jyjFFaMKuZh89RkMqQBSnbRwmMVllPhLhTZSRfDej53UBGMi6AGgWiMi9vztNuZWm7ZjsR5wV2LQ75vw21n18Zh-FIsO1_8vnYLJFkDO7OIUalXKxjLRsYQuQ8ImE8po7VhI_Ny4JKSuV11hzgqw%3D)_**

Here's why this matters more than you might think.

When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line.

Democrats are not leaving blank files. Their activists are filling out every survey, returning every call, and showing up at every meeting. They are building the most complete voter intelligence operation this party has ever run -- and they are doing it right now, while most conservatives are still enjoying their summer.

I know what a healthy file looks like -- and I know what a gap looks like. Right now, your file has a gap. Here's why this matters more than you might think. When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line. Democrats are not leaving blank files. One of the most important components of the American Dream—buying a home—is falling further and further out of reach for so many. Our community isn’t immune from that challenge, as too many families struggle to find a place to call home. I’ve worked to take on this challenge here in Phoenix, and I’m proud that our community is a national leader in building new housing. Since I’ve taken office, Phoenix has built or preserved 69,000 housing units—and our City Council created the Phoenix Housing Trust Fund to give us another tool to help open new doors of opportunity. We’re investing millions of voter-approved funds in housing for seniors and encouraging new housing through affordable housing loans and the redevelopment of city-owned land. Phoenix is also helping families become homeowners through down payment assistance. We know that just a little help can change the trajectory of a family’s path in such a positive way. I’m not alone. But accomplishing those goals depends on who controls the House.

**2\. Protect Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act.** Families should not lose coverage or face dramatically higher premiums because of a vote in Washington.

**3\. Defend Social Security and Medicare.** Central Florida seniors earned these benefits, and we must protect them.

**4\. Continue investing in our growing region.** Infrastructure, transportation, disaster preparedness, and high-paying technology jobs require effective federal partnerships.

**5\. Protect FL-09 and change the House majority.** Our district has been dramatically redrawn, making the resources needed to communicate with new voters more important than ever.

Donald Trump has been trying to gut birthright citizenship since the moment he took office. Here’s what’s happened: **_First_** , he signed an Executive Order illegally ending it on the day of his inauguration. Within 24 hours, I filed a lawsuit in federal court challenging the order. We fought hard, and won multiple nationwide injunctions blocking it from taking effect. **_Then_** , this June, the Supreme Court issued a ruling in another case that permanently struck down Trump’s illegal order. Unfortunately, Trump wasn’t done — just two months later he turned around and signed _another_ Executive Order to restrict birthright citizenship. **_Now_** , another court has ruled against him and blocked that second order. **These victories show what is possible when we keep up the fight with the facts and the law on our side.** Never before in history has a President been so determined to trample on the fundamental rights of this nation — from the right to vote to the freedom of speech to the right to bodily autonomy to the right to citizenship for every child born in this country. _But Trump’s historic insistence on brazenly and repeatedly violating the law and the Constitution has been met by an equally historic people-powered movement for justice and accountability — thanks to you._ **[I'm running for re-election to keep this movement going, and I’m asking you to stand by my side. | | Friends, Eli Savit is now the Democratic nominee for Michigan Attorney General. His record as Washtenaw County Prosecutor provides voters with a clear contrast with [my approach to public safety, enforcement of the law, and responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUeQhN8PAcSJ-42lRAmdDW_lvbPj-60SuGX5Tu7qscq9pMo2vDuePmLIRsE5WHWsjaziaW44HR09VLPmS-PFqUXEusKiplBrakqbtPZ0j8CVfuIUfGKRTM6F_Q54CoIqjW8MaYPECJfT2nVxHdXId0HRnjXvxes3SKwdnW0-rFC4z&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==)
Savit has pursued a prosecutorial philosophy that has drawn criticism from law enforcement and others who believe prosecutors should be more aggressive in holding offenders accountable.
The central question for voters is not simply whether Eli Savit has exercised prosecutorial discretion. [It is what philosophy they want guiding Michigan's top law-enforcement office.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUeQhN8PAcSJ-42lRAmdDW_lvbPj-60SuGX5Tu7qscq9pMo2vDuePmLIRsE5WHWsjaziaW44HR09VLPmS-PFqUXEusKiplBrakqbtPZ0j8CVfuIUfGKRTM6F_Q54CoIqjW8MaYPECJfT2nVxHdXId0HRnjXvxes3SK1vR2COEfv_5&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==)
Savit has demonstrated a willingness to limit prosecution of certain offenses and pursue policies designed to reduce criminal penalties and incarceration. Yet despite serving as a prosecutor, he has never taken a criminal case to trial. His experience has instead centered on filing briefs and using the courts to wage political fights.
[I have a 30-year record as a career prosecutor and provide a different model: protect victims, support law enforcement, enforce the law, hold offenders accountable, and treat taxpayer resources with respect.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUeQhN8PAcSJ-42lRAmdDW_lvbPj-60SuGX5Tu7qscq9pMo2vDuePmLIRsE5WHWsjaziaW44HR09VLPmS-PFqUXEusKiplBrakqbtPZ0j8CVfuIUfGKRTM6F_Q54CoIqjW8MaYPECJfT2nVxHdXId0HRnjXvxes3SK26KUui47aLz&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==)
Bottom line: Michigan voters will have a clear choice between two fundamentally different approaches to the Attorney General's office. ____
As Washtenaw County Prosecutor, Savit has refused to do his job. When a repeat sex offender violated their sex offender registration, Savit gave him a [slap on the wrist](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUZ0NDWsRIaSxchbVy64t9erNpn38OMBxrurY8TKwu4CwU8aFbV9CTPnE2Vn5o1Ik0RfNRdRwlZnn5c14zFB84hFTPv9APCk9PeYmFEo0q2-HU-wiuMOViwJldxrFj1HrvqFoy9Iv-FNfNYO0NiPlOA95KkmvpLI1vcljv3aBpZpPpBNR9blR0no0o_eIEHgAmAJQzjYMgDR54J52WnDN1K5qC3vNItoN-oq81TDsDdbT&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==). Two years later, that same man broke into a woman's home, sexually assaulted her, and murdered her. Savit gave [a plea deal](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUQ3yiglr2kLczDDv9QcqOmNZVlE-INTcv-CRHhCp_2s_XwEEuWhF2slm2_Fr1FTo8nQkhJT4E41Xpl9nPHy4GcUMD1Y7P2baG34qWYEhsRNm82VmoO7lITYTkQqVoeotSp4UV1Ki8LlQ3Cs6vjXhxU58xhwPHzolC_Z64V9lsUpZbssDLo9TEik5nLxJ0Qn9_r2xDRjpk3qE&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==) with lesser charges to a man that hog-tied a woman and suffocated her with a plastic bag while threatening to sexually assault her. The criminal allegedly went on to carjack and shoot a mom in front of her child in Oakland County. Recently, [a federal judge ruled](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUZ0NDWsRIaSxc-j2wWPXs64Wr8_UuEPSYf0pICSQQsDkudYsFoRFcQZ1Fw6RMyFAITgt45MDR6lePlStmlm0745gGh9DKtdS1R_QuEBuhxgcFSoI04GJ2ewT2KNqZUPIxNIb5wZ5zIGahKahw8wkdO1vQu5ZQZPxdlMSDq1RP6vxGkMi-E6FlV-cLu1gxXHaOqHY6xlVlp3fnl2-V01gyDBQ1UDwESZCZMvKBlEcTE_5Y1vcxyasp-VevEUbXTpx16_jVXD5seV4Bv5XRe3y1A0OoVJ9Ri5YTQ==&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==) Savit can continue to not prosecute illegal immigrants that commit crimes, no matter how heinous, in Washtenaw County if it could trigger "immigration consequences." Savit has also [legalized psychedelic drugs and prostitution](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUZ0NDWsRIaSxJ5-mj8jr_Tx6nBrB0s3SfLx5QdDhyRQk2fV3KmQIo77FRgLMhmRcnxT9IxckjiLntpKED_rfdWzJae_WRUKtGKbn2TBUgzLESL1Fv-31EvlD2JdI4LMAAuIUoZXI-rDBXncG8r6HNVFAh2-J1L9oq3FEPIodzm4UiMpymHIn1ra4fPaLrH1ofeGk9GKsT1TO5YzTmR3Zp77rwQ5nyhnurA==&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==) by refusing to charge offenders, undermined our legal marijuana market by refusing to prosecute anyone for attempting to illegally traffic [500 pounds of black market marijuana](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUehTacTfwL-GTuPY03-jPwp8ACvhrahJ3gBeoLeqw7BAPLDXTNQAsGCXh3Fox7AdGmzH8qLNyW9pEfGxl2SOO-Vo43RnYDBI9IQwMobGBkPydl6dsvVdryHLQK1D8_XH9QjBLzf4boRc_uc2WiikMK8uaZGdGoHt9e-w6JMYoO0HY_PXbyRdeG60g11aYR1DpWw7yMWQaro94gaZC-rghXq6IcjBU3EMN9eU7JU3AnrBlUa_imE8uBdlaWFF6CvhuU42ry1lvk8ST8hPEp-31n9YSTLuZKBmNuU8BtpGPQNL4D41gUIQMPkTM0kZNKBZPKubIbbdDUHu2CYGzLRK12M3H55gxtHcsLpAs3kTwRHbTxJmF2uAMLP5CBf57rK10iWiA_Ci2ln0wFHKK2EZQUkbf1c8378A3b_Qs_cIdGyFTpXOH1-7MYonX26fk9DdKMw2AdF96QT6J-RFXn-C5tvQ7_kqg-I9HhXWvQl9D7J0OsQPn2--uec=&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==), and [ended cash bail](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUZ0NDWsRIaSxc-RIG-JCbpAIYiBJ3y4sj7ESYeDQR1X7pY_k5FGfgwLf7brqSmF-uzKrst7JoSemv8ix1hK8h9LfFoan4aNedIuD7brSdaM-56-DdIDZ_gUHqtCow_iI0tXYpU1WTZS8UL0g_mlgW5oT183jWhPfRPITRHNTnskqPqAqb9kzelnRtRQuz1ZiBG9E6mPg8JHE&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==). And he refused to prosecute 40 anti-Israel protestors after they occupied a University of Michigan building and [injured two police officers](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUehTacTfwL-Gv6cAZZL9iEUNutcrg8Ohgd0n5q0OFDh7Evqy4hjN_ZATyqYk0LUW4nS64kPdy89mZd1urL9OUxD7_Ny5gInoNtIzSq619KcSiYdi1otv0UincSuMoc2O5qRl8McW_PkvserB7-eVBOeECfeJ8bmOYVJMcR0zziZtL0iXMHrIr0wz-raxPm5QU_mA6yM2vOhNNBQugAF1CPk=&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==). Eli Savit is a prosecutor who won't prosecute. He refuses to do his job and now he wants a promotion to be Michigan's top law enforcement official? [No thank you.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUeQhN8PAcSJ-42lRAmdDW_lvbPj-60SuGX5Tu7qscq9pMo2vDuePmLIRsE5WHWsjaziaW44HR09VLPmS-PFqUXEusKiplBrakqbtPZ0j8CVfuIUfGKRTM6F_Q54CoIqjW8MaYPECJfT2nVxHdXId0HRnjXvxes3SKyoFQ8-MJpAM&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==) [Please consider donating to my campaign so that we can keep Michigan citizen's safe, criminals accountable and fraud, waste and abuse out of our government.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CIpQEIE-f2d9s_94ElZreN1FH3e1y4mL6eXMYooyhPIoSGoURSmFUeQhN8PAcSJ-42lRAmdDW_lvbPj-60SuGX5Tu7qscq9pMo2vDuePmLIRsE5WHWsjaziaW44HR09VLPmS-PFqUXEusKiplBrakqbtPZ0j8CVfuIUfGKRTM6F_Q54CoIqjW8MaYPECJfT2nVxHdXId0HRnjXvxes3SKwZNlv2iLgWk&c=7W_PqOJ5wtFa5dmVaTUyx2-yu0Z4lloDufD1ODArSo0LobBrYPekiQ==&ch=WelFbmGehYL7qESV2IzdsuG0s2n79gIO0Z_CJqDfx1obgn2u2VnDTQ==)

Mamdani-backed candidates Brad Lander (NY-10), Darializa Avila Chevalier (NY-13), and Claire Valdez (NY-7) all won their Democratic primaries this summer, delivering a major victory for the Democratic Socialists of America wing of the Democrat party.
The Associated Press reported that Mamdani "waded into Democratic U.S. House primaries" to boost the three progressives, all of whom won. The New York Post reported that Mamdani campaigned for all three DSA-backed candidates on primary day.
BerlinRosen's fingerprints are all over the primary victories of Mamdani's radical friends. They cheered or supported Mamdani's candidates, as the firm also has direct connections to Mamdani's staff.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7bfea129-ca8a-4464-a175-bea9eb92ab27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Loomered.com's reporting has [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/dd6744d5-4a85-42d8-85b7-233f3d64f91f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) how BerlinRosen helped normalize and professionalize the anti-Israel, Marxist-Islamist faction now capturing major Democrat races. Take Brad Lander, for example
Lander, who defeated sitting Democrat Congressman Dan Goldman in the NY-10 Democratic primary, has a long relationship with BerlinRosen. Lander paid BerlinRosen [more than any other firm](https://substack.com/redirect/18563f61-9d6a-484e-902b-0e483536c67f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) during his failed 2025 mayoral campaign. The "behemoth firm" brought in more than $43,000 from Lander's mayoral campaign shortly after his official launch. BerlinRosen had already been on the payroll for Lander's pre-existing comptroller campaign. Public New York City Campaign Finance Board records for Lander's 2025 mayoral campaign show more than $8.2 million in total disbursements.
In 2021, BerlinRosen co-founder Valerie Berlin publicly praised Lander on her personal X account, writing:
> _" Proud to support Brad Lander for NYC Comptroller -- a true ally and champion for LGBTQ+ rights."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fb6af8ae-ac2e-49c1-b77f-78691707291f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

---|---|---
When Mayor Mamdani's socialist machine elevated Lander against Goldman, it was not a grassroots recruitment effort, it was a strategic decision made by Mamdani and BerlinRosen to expand their influence.
BerlinRosen's clients also got in on the action.
SEIU, which appears on BerlinRosen's own client page as part of the firm's selected client portfolio, endorsed Lander over Goldman. BerlinRosen's website says the firm becomes a "fully integrated part" of its clients' teams, showing just how closely aligned the firm is with the same Marxist-Islamists who are reshaping the Democratic Party.
In April, Lander celebrated SEIU's endorsement on Instagram, writing:
> _"[SEIU] fights like hell & wins big for its members -- building service workers, security guards, airport workers -- and for working people more broadly. I'm deeply honored to have their support in this race."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4073b930-926d-4bb2-ba1e-aeb479269d46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

SEIU was not the only labor organization with a BerlinRosen affiliation to back Mamdani's hand-selected congressional challengers.

The American Federation of Government Employees, another union displayed on BerlinRosen's client page, endorsed Claire Valdez before Tuesday's election. Valdez proudly displayed AFGE's endorsement on her campaign website alongside Zohran Mamdani's endorsement. On AFGE's endorsement page, Valdez's name appeared alongside House Democrat Leader Hakeem Jeffries.
On election day, a group of mostly white leftists yelled "You're Next" at Jeffries - an explicit threat to primary him with candidates even further left than he is. If current New York political trends hold, Rep. Jeffries, Nancy Pelosi's handpicked successor, may not stand a chance against the ascending Marxist-Islamists who'd like to unseat him from power.
The socialist insurgents are no longer outside the gates. They are being embraced by mainstream Democrats in a cynical attempt to harness their enthusiasm to win elections. Adapt to what? Socialism? Antisemitism? Sharia Law?
BerlinRosen has built a radical client network that now overlaps with the faction taking control of the Democrat Party from the inside. For the first time in recorded history, people 65 and older [now outnumber children](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLEO2yAURb8Gb1gYU5IMDKkqtnTp0G4Whof9WgwRPMfK31duPqHz0b3SOT8f08Nhwrx8dxsYimXKcLQERFCnJZXZJbdgXnxJCRZohP4P1EkKqbm4caEm5wlfMCnXBRMBJIwdmOFyvX4ZtBJjtxohYPQxzCCd1EqNzol5iFp7rwav9dyhOf_ETahBCK2GPrgrxKhD1MMtiktgSkBAKrX_XTDTCjG9ywtq78vWJbMSPRsb70xaJu1xHP3W8smYtJD53pi0pxaTttAKlUm7YqNS0fOItREvKUDlLuyJGs_l4GWnvG8zVE4r8HfZ8ynP_YopVMg8lg_5zAk3YNK6yu93OdMvjGy0xWNg47evZ1w42g-oz66a8DwwJWz6wpRYNofpnwT9Z_uXkX8DAAD__2IpnZo) under 5 worldwide, according to a new U.S. Census report released this week. More than 71% of humanity now lives in countries with birthrates below the replacement level, up from 45% a decade ago. That means fewer workers supporting more retirees, straining pensions and Social Security. The U.S. ranks 48th-oldest among 227 countries, with nearly 19% of Americans 65 or older. The report also calls longer lifespans "one of the great achievements of the last century" and notes that many seniors keep contributing to society through work, caregiving, and volunteering.

name: Darline Graham
subject: My brother raised me when I was 13
body:
Lindsey promised me things would be okay. I've watched him keep that promise to South Carolina ever since. Now, it’s my turn. |
---

Peter,

There's a moment I've never forgotten.

I was 11 when we lost our mom. A little over a year later, we lost our dad, too. Our family business - a pool hall and bar right on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - still needed to be run. And I was wondering what came next.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=08f63003888940e493f6a8d0db1d50ed&_e=HJUdykL-VQAaoK9tJZb2NxF_UNddKtj3ZlxLsnSRkXvrMwi_quOMH_pawWHunJiXlH0FWhpi7Zosc4paotZMzhSk-YiMG2hjlSWyT3IKf2KYkxTXaPExdDy-e3w76i9a1pXviRr38McHi7u8WPO23Ox7qKfZtcxXIYCqAjyrRPmCdQrdTYg75k29mQ58xykRJHkC12_AsV9oCFgCmTrOneEuJZTQi5CpZCBYAKo9qggg985-On8O-LWVm_ZF1kt7tqB1IthDnNUAiWzvSLBKeowN9KTByJ8l34Gujz2Fe5LGQVCbtUyGGZKr9HmLVuHOZuovnSG38xLw6PPn6wuPNaiI-0-eBkS3D5zh4RJZc-NB0wBGL92Fl2dYWM_zZUuaxK1WFabKdcesQWpQgLoEtesS1tQwugjgeV4K04ZA-p8FaFJLMcnTzvTeN6bnP6V74BZdxDpYLHccJGeAg321_SHUrqXN_den1ZhouNXDAf9VebPoCMIQJwU-BlQKucxzILZLhkCvdemvQ9P59gi_NXTEcC7faIc100S0dpv9JtOH65NNcpRYbsXUTa5IxOByubLasgQX6h0dBghzU1xqTFA6lfjz5UVST_77UQ1lopHgIqfDuw3pk72fgKRGee3PsbbYxjh6tS_xIiH9tRdQYSkpyu1qH1gEdL7a1DvWTsUhaB_mR2nXReNb52SyXViVBfo6hWf6ENEUPrRzi3XQvw%3D%3D)
My brother Lindsey figured it out.

He was in college, and he came home on weekends to take care of me and keep the doors open. It wasn't easy for him, but he made sure I had what I needed. That's just what he always did.

Our folks never finished high school. They ran the Sanitary Cafe - part bar, part restaurant, part pool hall - and we lived in the back of it, right there on Main Street. Lindsey swept those floors right alongside me. We both heard those conversations of working people from the textile mills, stopping in after their shift, talking about what they needed, what they hoped for, and what kept them up at night.

Those people shaped him a lot more than much else ever did.

After college and law school, he joined the Air Force. There he served as a military prosecutor and defense attorney. Even after South Carolina sent him to the Statehouse, Congress and finally, the Senate, he kept his commission. His service included short deployments to Afghanistan and Iraq where he stood shoulder to shoulder with 19-year-olds from little towns just like ours who were willing to give everything.

You want to know why he fought so hard in Washington? _Because he knew who was counting on him._

It's the family in Greenville stretching a paycheck that doesn't quite reach. The veteran in Spartanburg that earned every benefit he gets. The business owner in Florence who built something from nothing and doesn't need the government to make it harder.

These are his people. And right now, they need someone in their corner.

**The radical left in this country today:** they want open borders, higher taxes, and more government in your life. They'll smile and tell you it's for your own good.

I'm here to tell you it isn't.

**[Peter, I'm asking for your help today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=08f63003888940e493f6a8d0db1d50ed&_e=HJUdykL-VQAaoK9tJZb2NxF_UNddKtj3ZlxLsnSRkXvrMwi_quOMH_pawWHunJiXlH0FWhpi7Zosc4paotZMzhSk-YiMG2hjlSWyT3IKf2KYkxTXaPExdDy-e3w76i9a1pXviRr38McHi7u8WPO23Ox7qKfZtcxXIYCqAjyrRPmCdQrdTYg75k29mQ58xykRJHkC12_AsV9oCFgCmTrOneEuJZTQi5CpZCBYAKo9qggg985-On8O-LWVm_ZF1kt7p7V9Cc_BZin3AgEIVOnZmTJ9yHj0PBkwxy-C4_3-KHXARfa4LglUDo4kmisMeh0rRvZOHjav3g-XMi3qjHyqYEXVlz8dlCUNqA9OblBtEaj6ljkau_9X4zVG1IknSfmzOclTkrln5FgRjw7ADlOf_KfXuRnfCVQRiufI5dq0kk4SRBeNNOWDoL1E0bYmojJsj6AuFu37byikUnb05tmL2KKTLkuLieOEGzpZDa--lym5N48YCPfk-bFAOdWoYXaSLn7Mlxn8kjblp5C4XdwZcYfqfG4uTSuQTvcrrZRYrBpthrtJTsUFitP3kdWPecyW97aLENDtk4vN5Lofv_uzVvzpZ8RQuDYdd0NcFoyxRxbbB71MM_FPw2ynL_eVrKP01ecCjr3X-9gJUkUUCLC1OQ6cFXxCdYef1FC0G2kM_cotguSF7Rz_kfKyXJHarlxCSUcMRj7HPadagxVi9yXEkg%3D%3D)** The legacy my brother built can never be replicated, but I can honor him by working as hard as he did every single day for the great people of South Carolina.

All those years ago, he promised me things would be okay. Now, it's my turn to pick up where he left off and make sure the people he loved, South Carolinians from the Grand Strand to the Golden Corner, are okay.

I can't let him down. That's why, when President Trump asked me to run, I answered the call.

clean_body: Lindsey promised me things would be okay. I've watched him keep that promise to South Carolina ever since. Now, it’s my turn. | Peter, There's a moment I've never forgotten. I was 11 when we lost our mom. A little over a year later, we lost our dad, too. Our family business - a pool hall and bar right on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - still needed to be run. And I was wondering what came next. My brother Lindsey figured it out. He was in college, and he came home on weekends to take care of me and keep the doors open. It wasn't easy for him, but he made sure I had what I needed. That's just what he always did. Our folks never finished high school. They ran the Sanitary Cafe - part bar, part restaurant, part pool hall - and we lived in the back of it, right there on Main Street. Lindsey swept those floors right alongside me. We both heard those conversations of working people from the textile mills, stopping in after their shift, talking about what they needed, what they hoped for, and what kept them up at night. Those people shaped him a lot more than much else ever did. After college and law school, he joined the Air Force. There he served as a military prosecutor and defense attorney. Even after South Carolina sent him to the Statehouse, Congress and finally, the Senate, he kept his commission. His service included short deployments to Afghanistan and Iraq where he stood shoulder to shoulder with 19-year-olds from little towns just like ours who were willing to give everything. You want to know why he fought so hard in Washington? Because he knew who was counting on him. It's the family in Greenville stretching a paycheck that doesn't quite reach. The veteran in Spartanburg that earned every benefit he gets. The business owner in Florence who built something from nothing and doesn't need the government to make it harder. These are his people. And right now, they need someone in their corner. The radical left in this country today: they want open borders, higher taxes, and more government in your life. They'll smile and tell you it's for your own good. I'm here to tell you it isn't. The legacy my brother built can never be replicated, but I can honor him by working as hard as he did every single day for the great people of South Carolina. I am starting this General Election behind financially. All those years ago, he promised me things would be okay. Now, it's my turn to pick up where he left off and make sure the people he loved, South Carolinians from the Grand Strand to the Golden Corner, are okay. I can't let him down. That's why, when President Trump asked me to run, I answered the call. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart. ## Dallas Council Backs Flock Funding
The Dallas City Council [voted 12-3 Wednesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpiAURp9GO_5cEUQKim3sZtstzQUuShbBIPs78_Yb5xWmO8mXnOR8fz7WD4wp5u03HmTaZyhrpvtK1BrVb8SMuZUcy1lSdOT2SKGtHPjEQDMQK7oW37QK7L2x4PXQkxnUPMtBKw39bgRXEOSIUs0hAPlJaDVOjvSghlHpuY_m0YEGMQwwwvySg-cjoiQtPdhAnQDysZX6ajs1-sQrpK_ypvpy5eiT2Vs7r2781fGl48t93687ID5jxxesLbpEHV-enI4vT0iL7kGPKeHFborbfjHKPuaNhVTcX-bwoIrsrGWreLCzxje6L2b_-Y0acyU7qvlx8FkxoVA7QY6BtMgEADE7oWXWklQyKKfI9tX4844pxWtSnYDtwJi-A9pPj38b_j8AAP__XDWZGQ) to reject a proposal removing $1.5 million in Flock funding from the proposed city budget. Council member Adam Bazaldua proposed ending the contract and redirecting the money to neighborhood improvements and legal assistance for residents facing eviction. Dallas police argued that the cameras help officers identify vehicles, develop leads, and solve crimes. A separate pause in state funding will [shut down 321 Flock cameras](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OpDAMRZ8mdEFO-BuKFNvQzbZbIpOYwdqQIPDCzNuvmFf4OstX5-ro_nmOT-TI6fUbV3LynvOY6DoiidD-PTFhkpw4bzmyJ78wzTJasK2GXkM9ohc-aayxCG6C0JuCnOkej8b0XQ_F4uxspxl6oKppJ6AQyCB2TaDWQNviVLC766CH2hio4FE2JtgKsaG-CTDNpGqgwJL3UhYSeuMxx08-aS99XovoFpHtUNUvZQdlh-u6Sj8dt_ydKzt8EWWH-6XsEDBGPLRn-Wif_yXPUZ9ZSM8x-7_a40o7Hnrb-UT_0QEFtc_J055uvNhd2C6OkY-2UzW8VuT4NZGfLng6-z8AAP__udqJpw) in Dallas on Sept. 15. Police said more than 300 other cameras will remain in operation. Opponents have [raised concerns](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd1gHDP4pKNK427QprWM4rFEwWIasN29_5b2PcLtPo9HMaP48lgeGGNLzN-5k6tvnJdFVItVK5wcxYao5hXzkGCzZLZCviwTZc5g4qAVtDS9aFDbOrOAm0ZARwzhqMQ0TNJvpZN-DXkepRi-96K321goNagVpB7k2wdxxMIESAjoYWy2c7BA1TdrB6okpIBdqPtu6UaU3Fh__5xedrc17E81W61FY94vJmcn5uq7W57e6198GJucbmZyPMx-5YOSUXEhP7mO2f7nFnU7k_t-36DBGLNxjiKU5jTuuEGMo_cAUPHcM8VNaf3rWy8ivAAAA___dTYFf) about data sharing, possible misuse, and lack of the public's trust. The council is expected to make its final decision on the program as part of the city budget within two weeks.
## Salame Named San Antonio Police Chief
San Antonio City Manager Erik Walsh [selected Jesse Salame](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDtu6zAQRVcjdTQo6suCxWvU-bUphZE4tCbgRyAHtrP7QHaALCDdYHBwce_5uC5XIE_x9h8CGn66tER8FI_MmF8nRIicIqUjedpw2wkdL0qqQUgtZLfAxnTHpYPamlVa3dRomnGa-kaPWta7aXs7jHZzk9bjMIxytStu69RNa-8Gq8aazBknteyaRrZyuvSNVS1Aj7q3cnVYdRItccoX3pHxCcX5r3THfNlSqL3ZmY9Stf8qNVdqdun52_okKjWfSyo1UywMtwznq0AUP5CIELAIioyZgnhtFJ9YCooCHgIKKOLAHCBiZPE28cbqbOzxIO-pDGPVyVsA8q9a_Fedd6O-AwAA__8bkY8M) to permanently lead the San Antonio Police Department following a nationwide search that drew more than 30 applicants. Salame has served as acting chief since July and has spent 27 years with the department. He graduated from the police academy in 1999, spent a decade as a detective, and was promoted to deputy chief in 2022. He succeeds William McManus, the longest-serving police chief in San Antonio history. Salame said his priorities include promoting public safety, keeping violent crime down, and strengthening community trust. The [City Council is scheduled](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2unTAQhJ_GdHtkDOanoEhDd9OmRMt6OTjXP8j2PZz79hEkb5BqLI08o2_218fygdbZ8PyJnqfy3uIS-MyOS-F0PzFgKDHYeERniWm3vJVFSdWBHEG2C1KxL15arMy0SjPWFU91Pwy6HvtRVvtk1qYllkpSzay2TXcDIbHZGNuuMaay0xUnR9nWtWzk8NC1UQ2i5lEbuW4sWsnGlpgeZefCb8yb-44vTg-KvnLTXsqRRfNDqFmo-TzPxyeHrC9XqBlTseRYqPniEWp2kdBdiidw2GIi9hyKUHPGAP9w4e6BjOUNgU_4iw83P_zmnBkyOvSXHAYSF5uuFDitcxY9ePIYvmwGsuUbKH4Fsg48BnxyAk72E050eQcM4TLvz5mPwn7lBNckQs2qb0BSv2ocJXSaCdqmVoCaamho6IduGHRDWKXJHHd17nrRyqdH6-55yv-e9TWpPwEAAP__WiS8cg) to confirm his appointment Sept. 10.
## Thunderclap Triggers Magnolia School Lockdowns
Several Magnolia ISD schools were [placed on lockdown Thursday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ8Gd0SwhhgKF9e4-6-90lrDEtARE-H949zbn5J7hOtGGmlmvvn1tX5hqWW__cQ7zfxKbd3pPCoxU_9I3HHntpf2aLUECrlQ4hUUXKXyUpkVA5cnrQaHOG8qej3QrCfnrPaTV0Oe3ZaM3dTVePTW2GBUTBEn2KwzLthxKPM7TnlltFajcherI4yIlryNakskjKJYuPULZ2J64ZHqn_akfgntPtQ5Mz8OMf4QsAhYzvO8_M7t-20KWLBzCZUELG8cAUttAauAhQlDpi45f--RuvwHIo_cGlOXd7ztrRaUn0IBCzgrk1dTDGGTMGmUJnot_TRa6RyCC4GSBj_0OT7OUms5rpMw6nbHUj9L-X8ffs7wNwAA__-3Z5AD) after a teacher at Willie E. Williams Elementary mistook a clap of thunder for a gunshot. The teacher was in an interior room and did not know a storm was moving into the area, district officials said. After hearing the loud noise around 12:45 p.m., the teacher called 911. Every Marine carries their record. Not on a wall. In how they carry themselves for the rest of their life.

Mine says Sergeant. It says K-9 handler. It says I stood post so someone else could sleep. I didn't earn it to win an argument. I
earned it at twenty-one, working dogs on flight lines, because that was the job.

Stolen valor is serious. You do not throw that at a Marine unless you have every fact. Stephen Skoly did not have them. He
attacked anyway.

I am a United States Marine. I am the only veteran in this Republican primary. Skoly never served. One week before September 9 —
after early voting had already started — he went after my military record with a partial file and treated it like the whole story.
That is not due diligence. That is a smear.

I enlisted. I served as a military policeman and a military working-dog handler. My job was finding explosives. I was
meritoriously promoted to sergeant. I served with FAST Company, the Fleet Anti-terrorism Security Team. They issued me a letter
thanking me for the work.

How dare he tell Republican voters to doubt that service without the complete record. How dare a man who never wore the uniform
put a Marine in the stolen-valor bucket to save a sinking campaign.

He did not spend the closing weeks of this race on energy prices. Not on housing. Not on the roads we rank dead last in. He spent
it digging through a Marine's file looking for dirt.

When you attack a veteran's honorable service for political gain, you do not just disrespect one man. You disrespect every veteran
who earned the right to have that service treated with respect.

Dr. Skoly gave his word he would not run this kind of campaign. He gave it publicly. Then he broke it.

Rhode Island has more than enough politicians who say one thing and do another. We do not need one more.

If this is his judgment under pressure, what other poor judgment should we expect from him in Congress?

I'm not asking you to vote against anyone. I'm asking you to vote for a Rhode Island that stops finishing last — and for a
candidate who will not trash a veteran to get there.

clean_body: Every Marine carries their record. Not on a wall. In how they carry themselves for the rest of their life. [] Every Marine carries their record. Not on a wall. In how they carry themselves for the rest of their life. Mine says Sergeant. It says K-9 handler. It says I stood post so someone else could sleep. I didn't earn it to win an argument. I earned it at twenty-one, working dogs on flight lines, because that was the job. Stolen valor is serious. You do not throw that at a Marine unless you have every fact. Stephen Skoly did not have them. He attacked anyway. I am a United States Marine. I am the only veteran in this Republican primary. Skoly never served. One week before September 9 — after early voting had already started — he went after my military record with a partial file and treated it like the whole story. That is not due diligence. That is a smear. I enlisted. I served as a military policeman and a military working-dog handler. My job was finding explosives. I was meritoriously promoted to sergeant. I served with FAST Company, the Fleet Anti-terrorism Security Team. They issued me a letter thanking me for the work. How dare he tell Republican voters to doubt that service without the complete record. How dare a man who never wore the uniform put a Marine in the stolen-valor bucket to save a sinking campaign. He did not spend the closing weeks of this race on energy prices. Not on housing. Not on the roads we rank dead last in. He spent it digging through a Marine's file looking for dirt. When you attack a veteran's honorable service for political gain, you do not just disrespect one man. You disrespect every veteran who earned the right to have that service treated with respect. Dr. Skoly gave his word he would not run this kind of campaign. He gave it publicly. Then he broke it. Rhode Island has more than enough politicians who say one thing and do another. We do not need one more. If this is his judgment under pressure, what other poor judgment should we expect from him in Congress? I'm not asking you to vote against anyone. I'm asking you to vote for a Rhode Island that stops finishing last — and for a candidate who will not trash a veteran to get there. Don't just take my word for it. Read Skoly's email for yourself CLICK HERE! [ marketing] Thank you for standing with me and all those who have worn the nation's uniform. If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

clean_body: Patriot, You hear it every time you turn on the news... " Donald Trump wants to be King." "Donald Trump is a dictator." "Donald Trump is a Nazi." But actually, it's President Trump's leftist foes who are the true authoritarians. These aren't saviors of democracy. They 're Marxists. Because if the radical left gets their way, these things will be gone forever... I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark is here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism...in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. | | Dear Friend,

Have you noticed how hard it is to make sense of arguments today?

Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television...quick reactions in comments online...everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.

That's why we put together a **free Logic and Rhetoric Guide** --to help you think more clearly, evaluate the various opinions you hear and read daily, and make stronger, more persuasive arguments.

**You can download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcFq3DAQhp9GvtlII63tPehQqjUUmpSSQ49Gkcb2EFkSlpyQty9bsi_Q6zfwDR__n6f5yVKguD7bHTWVMvvk57pRfHMB7RE-bfQlo337oLq5GTj0Lb-2XM3WVXrHWdnG6wuIcRkb1GIYxwtIpXiz6Vclr14J14_iFa6LFdIJ8L3qhV8GJaAhfffxK1cCuLyMHSwopBDDAIpbuwxM8TN7W7GjWMhjcSnlnAJVcqVLx9oEvdWaC5PfGEwMJopL6jYKoXgbsEN_MphCWsm1x4Y1HeTaUk__2a4neWRyKo5Jw2EY-DMHBT9vxvwyt9t3Bv1Z97mk83DIpMlHKhldpbh-nXb0dO5MGtwthS_o7J4trZFJ8-_tA6dYMVYmze-h_fHy0j7Km0P7_EEhUOnvvevd1bm0N_V_93jX8DcAAP__3b6atg)

Inside, you'll discover how to:
* Recognize when an argument is sound, or when it falls apart

* Distinguish facts from opinions and emotional appeals

* Think more clearly before reacting

* Express your ideas more clearly and persuasively

In short, your guide will help you do something that's becoming increasingly rare: **Think clearly --and speak with confidence.**

And it's not just theory (although there's a lot of that in the guide)!

These are practical tools you can start using right away...in conversations, while watching the news, and in daily decisions.

**The guide is completely free, and you can read it at your own pace.**

name: Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales
subject: Will you pray for these children?
body:
The situation isn't good.

| | | |
---
| |
---
| | | Dear Friend, "We have no place to go." That's what Sister Francois-Dorothee tells me the poor children of the impoverished town of Matjieskloof in South Africa keep telling her. The situation isn't good. The children of Matjieskloof always had a hard life. It's a small town where most of the homes are made of tin siding and indoor plumbing is non-existent. But now things have gotten so much worse. At the start of this past year, schools in South Africa were still shut down and the kids literally had no place to go. With no air conditioning, internet, or even much space in their homes, staying inside hasn't been an option in the sweltering African heat. **So kids have taken to playing in the small garbage dumps that litter the town. ** And those are the kids that haven't tragically fallen prey to alcohol, drugs, and other horrible things that the gangs of a nearby city peddle them. No one is watching these children and they have nowhere to go. [That's why the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales want to give those children a place of their own. And it's why I'm asking today if you'll help. ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckdGO2ywQhZ8G3xHBgB184Yv8m_hX1E1b7UrpJcIwTljZYAFOtW9fOeq-QO9GR2dmdM7366Ivxk8-3L6bGTv78Dpl_dtP02dcl2Q-x5jKHTPau59c0sCgoaylTGpji3-glqZynXWNgAo7vleqBslFXd07zmuBHBU4gFYyB0I0DTC3V4qBqFnlu-0ca5nkwGtR7wbXMomyBsMVBzMSydbFmYJ5Z2PImB5m--lDiNsUw87GuZq6eylLJuJAoCfQZ7Rrwp0J6GLZHAT6OEymIM0-F0yZxpHmQsdkgvWZOqTZTJgJ9IvZt9bCUNPGSUNl_TF_WEXNMDrqWo7DYOWguCKiX8usc1yTRSKOb6crgWaTZnR-nYk4ni6H8-tf0Zp5Mf4WiDg-IyvB9X_H__WP9_5dv52u-mnWl2-vPf15oC_X89diDAVDIeL4cj3Tr7qq1Lllg-RzsyeS3Wbjp2cX5R8RPjr4EwAA__8cDKiO) **Sister Francois-Dorothee — who leads our mission in Matjieskloof — has cleared off some land** **and started building an outdoor community center (with the help of some older children)... ** **...so kids have a safe place to be kids.** The children in town are very excited and have been using their crayons to show how they would like this space to look. I wish you could see the beaming smiles on these children imagining what it would be like to have a place to play that isn't a garbage dump. But the Oblate Sisters would like this space to be so much more. We want this to be a place where children can be taught daily. Fed daily. And where our Sisters can pray with them daily. However, with just the Sisters and children themselves working on this center, progress has been moving far too slow. These children can't wait years. They're losing their childhoods right now. Unfortunately, it's not going to be cheap to hire professionals who can build quickly. And our Sisters in Matjieskloof just don't have that kind of money. **Which is why Sister Francois-Dorothee has asked me to reach out to people like you who might be able to help.** My name is Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder and I'm the North American Delegate for the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales. Saint Leonie Aviat founded the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales in 1866 after visiting a factory and seeing the harsh conditions that so many were working under. She knew that these least privileged in society especially needed to hear the words of Christ. Our mission in Matjieskloof was founded under her direction in 1885. **[And in our 138 years in Matjieskloof, I'm not sure if the children there have ever needed our help more than now. ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckdGO2ywQhZ8G3xHBgB184Yv8m_hX1E1b7UrpJcIwTljZYAFOtW9fOeq-QO9GR2dmdM7366Ivxk8-3L6bGTv78Dpl_dtP02dcl2Q-x5jKHTPau59c0sCgoaylTGpji3-glqZynXWNgAo7vleqBslFXd07zmuBHBU4gFYyB0I0DTC3V4qBqFnlu-0ca5nkwGtR7wbXMomyBsMVBzMSydbFmYJ5Z2PImB5m--lDiNsUw87GuZq6eylLJuJAoCfQZ7Rrwp0J6GLZHAT6OEymIM0-F0yZxpHmQsdkgvWZOqTZTJgJ9IvZt9bCUNPGSUNl_TF_WEXNMDrqWo7DYOWguCKiX8usc1yTRSKOb6crgWaTZnR-nYk4ni6H8-tf0Zp5Mf4WiDg-IyvB9X_H__WP9_5dv52u-mnWl2-vPf15oC_X89diDAVDIeL4cj3Tr7qq1Lllg-RzsyeS3Wbjp2cX5R8RPjr4EwAA__8cDKiO)**I know you're miles and miles away from these children, but today you can have a big impact on their lives. Specifically, I am asking you to do two things:
---
| | | **1\. Will you pray for the children of Matjieskloof?** Please pray they find the strength to make it through the hardships of their daily lives. **2\. Will you send a one-time gift of $25** so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them?
---
| | | [ **DONATE ** ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckdGO2ywQhZ8G3xHBgB184Yv8m_hX1E1b7UrpJcIwTljZYAFOtW9fOeq-QO9GR2dmdM7366Ivxk8-3L6bGTv78Dpl_dtP02dcl2Q-x5jKHTPau59c0sCgoaylTGpji3-glqZynXWNgAo7vleqBslFXd07zmuBHBU4gFYyB0I0DTC3V4qBqFnlu-0ca5nkwGtR7wbXMomyBsMVBzMSydbFmYJ5Z2PImB5m--lDiNsUw87GuZq6eylLJuJAoCfQZ7Rrwp0J6GLZHAT6OEymIM0-F0yZxpHmQsdkgvWZOqTZTJgJ9IvZt9bCUNPGSUNl_TF_WEXNMDrqWo7DYOWguCKiX8usc1yTRSKOb6crgWaTZnR-nYk4ni6H8-tf0Zp5Mf4WiDg-IyvB9X_H__WP9_5dv52u-mnWl2-vPf15oC_X89diDAVDIeL4cj3Tr7qq1Lllg-RzsyeS3Wbjp2cX5R8RPjr4EwAA__8cDKiO)
---

clean_body: The situation isn't good. | | | | | | | | | Dear Friend, "We have no place to go." That's what Sister Francois-Dorothee tells me the poor children of the impoverished town of Matjieskloof in South Africa keep telling her. The situation isn't good. The children of Matjieskloof always had a hard life. It's a small town where most of the homes are made of tin siding and indoor plumbing is non-existent. But now things have gotten so much worse. At the start of this past year, schools in South Africa were still shut down and the kids literally had no place to go. With no air conditioning, internet, or even much space in their homes, staying inside hasn't been an option in the sweltering African heat. So kids have taken to playing in the small garbage dumps that litter the town. And those are the kids that haven't tragically fallen prey to alcohol, drugs, and other horrible things that the gangs of a nearby city peddle them. No one is watching these children and they have nowhere to go. Sister Francois-Dorothee — who leads our mission in Matjieskloof — has cleared off some land and started building an outdoor community center (with the help of some older children)... ...so kids have a safe place to be kids. The children in town are very excited and have been using their crayons to show how they would like this space to look. I wish you could see the beaming smiles on these children imagining what it would be like to have a place to play that isn't a garbage dump. But the Oblate Sisters would like this space to be so much more. We want this to be a place where children can be taught daily. Fed daily. And where our Sisters can pray with them daily. However, with just the Sisters and children themselves working on this center, progress has been moving far too slow. These children can't wait years. They're losing their childhoods right now. Unfortunately, it's not going to be cheap to hire professionals who can build quickly. And our Sisters in Matjieskloof just don't have that kind of money. Which is why Sister Francois-Dorothee has asked me to reach out to people like you who might be able to help. My name is Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder and I'm the North American Delegate for the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales. Saint Leonie Aviat founded the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales in 1866 after visiting a factory and seeing the harsh conditions that so many were working under. She knew that these least privileged in society especially needed to hear the words of Christ. Our mission in Matjieskloof was founded under her direction in 1885. know you're miles and miles away from these children, but today you can have a big impact on their lives. Specifically, I am asking you to do two things: | | | 1\. Will you pray for the children of Matjieskloof? Please pray they find the strength to make it through the hardships of their daily lives. 2\. Will you send a one-time gift of $25 so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them? | | | | | | I understand that it might not be easy to spare much, especially right now. I would never want you to give money that you truly need for your own family. But I know we often spend $25 without really thinking about it on things we truly don't need. Dear Friend, **In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress.** On September 26, I will kick off this year's "See You at the Library" Story Hours at America's Library in Washington, D.C.Then, just one week later, something truly incredible will happen. Christian parents and grandparents across America will walk into their local public libraries with their children and grandchildren.And in a matter of hours, hundreds of Story Hours will fill children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.This is our chance to bring God's truth into libraries across America and reach an entire generation of children. **This year, honoring America's 250th birthday, our ambitious goal is to expand "See You at the Library Day" to reach 250,000 children.****And we are just ONE MONTH away.** Before then, I need you!The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host "Story Hours" has been overwhelming.But it's going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold "Story Hours" for 250,000 children.**And with just over one month left, the clock is running out to fund the Story Hours we need to reach 250,000 children.** **[That's why I'm asking you to rush back your tax-deductible sponsorship gift of $35, $50, $125, $250 or more today.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7WiQwx9LCy0cyDIKxI2RFim6IihyJBOQSEGiFfT2hdrkANl-eDOYb96vq7naMIY4fLcT1kOaZ7Os5h1THP_c7YYp4pRivhtgoCmrKJPGuhw2NNIWvpZWS611gTU_lqUCpYUo7rVnneeqEwz6TvdVL1XJu8qBUhzBgS5CvS9kFZMcJBP8gK5zqsfellbCkQGRDH3IaTnsRy24Bo8xBzseXJqKsb7nPK9EnAi0BNoV3WPBg43oU94TBNpusRvSPi10SMkTaGfLSi564UvaCeRUcqho2fmSWlFV_qi84E4R0T7yZNb0WBwS0bye3wjoHU3ow2MiojlfT9-eP6Cz02zDEIloPoy4eWou5qm9vJjX85v5FzY_fp9-PvMrvZ3o5eV2-xxOMWPMRDQ7pJ8vKZbaz-9hHMOqj0SyYbLhv3f-ckVbDX8DAAD__xscmKc)** Friend, America's children need to hear our message because today's "educators" and librarians are radicals! Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, radical activists have worked to turn our public libraries into vehicles for their values.But we can't just sit back and complain about it. **[That's why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through "See You at the Library Day."](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7WiQwx9LCy0cyDIKxI2RFim6IihyJBOQSEGiFfT2hdrkANl-eDOYb96vq7naMIY4fLcT1kOaZ7Os5h1THP_c7YYp4pRivhtgoCmrKJPGuhw2NNIWvpZWS611gTU_lqUCpYUo7rVnneeqEwz6TvdVL1XJu8qBUhzBgS5CvS9kFZMcJBP8gK5zqsfellbCkQGRDH3IaTnsRy24Bo8xBzseXJqKsb7nPK9EnAi0BNoV3WPBg43oU94TBNpusRvSPi10SMkTaGfLSi564UvaCeRUcqho2fmSWlFV_qi84E4R0T7yZNb0WBwS0bye3wjoHU3ow2MiojlfT9-eP6Cz02zDEIloPoy4eWou5qm9vJjX85v5FzY_fp9-PvMrvZ3o5eV2-xxOMWPMRDQ7pJ8vKZbaz-9hHMOqj0SyYbLhv3f-ckVbDX8DAAD__xscmKc)** We're countering those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And on October 3, a little boy or girl will stand up at their public library as straight and tall as they possibly can... ...as their right hand covers their heart, and they proudly pledge allegiance to our American flag.We'll teach them:**Freedom Requires Courage.****Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice.****IN GOD WE TRUST.** And we hope to engrave those lessons on every child's heart at "See You at the Library Day."But first, we have to get the resources into the hands of the parents, grandparents, and patriots who are organizing these Story Hours.Your tax-deductible sponsorship gift helps send a "Story Hour Kit" to volunteers organizing "See You at the Library" events. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. **[Knowing that, please consider a tax-deductible sponsorship gift of $125.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7WiQwx9LCy0cyDIKxI2RFim6IihyJBOQSEGiFfT2hdrkANl-eDOYb96vq7naMIY4fLcT1kOaZ7Os5h1THP_c7YYp4pRivhtgoCmrKJPGuhw2NNIWvpZWS611gTU_lqUCpYUo7rVnneeqEwz6TvdVL1XJu8qBUhzBgS5CvS9kFZMcJBP8gK5zqsfellbCkQGRDH3IaTnsRy24Bo8xBzseXJqKsb7nPK9EnAi0BNoV3WPBg43oU94TBNpusRvSPi10SMkTaGfLSi564UvaCeRUcqho2fmSWlFV_qi84E4R0T7yZNb0WBwS0bye3wjoHU3ow2MiojlfT9-eP6Cz02zDEIloPoy4eWou5qm9vJjX85v5FzY_fp9-PvMrvZ3o5eV2-xxOMWPMRDQ7pJ8vKZbaz-9hHMOqj0SyYbLhv3f-ckVbDX8DAAD__xscmKc)** That's enough to sponsor one entire "**Story Hour Kit** " yourself. **Singlehandedly, you'll be helping us reach approximately 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message.** But October 3 is getting closer every day.We don't have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA.We have something better: **Parents. Grandparents. Christians. Patriots. And people like you who refuse to surrender America's children.** **[Whatever you can give, whether it's $35, $125, $250, $500 or more, please send in your sponsorship gift today so we can sponsor as many Story Hours as possible before October 3.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7WiQwx9LCy0cyDIKxI2RFim6IihyJBOQSEGiFfT2hdrkANl-eDOYb96vq7naMIY4fLcT1kOaZ7Os5h1THP_c7YYp4pRivhtgoCmrKJPGuhw2NNIWvpZWS611gTU_lqUCpYUo7rVnneeqEwz6TvdVL1XJu8qBUhzBgS5CvS9kFZMcJBP8gK5zqsfellbCkQGRDH3IaTnsRy24Bo8xBzseXJqKsb7nPK9EnAi0BNoV3WPBg43oU94TBNpusRvSPi10SMkTaGfLSi564UvaCeRUcqho2fmSWlFV_qi84E4R0T7yZNb0WBwS0bye3wjoHU3ow2MiojlfT9-eP6Cz02zDEIloPoy4eWou5qm9vJjX85v5FzY_fp9-PvMrvZ3o5eV2-xxOMWPMRDQ7pJ8vKZbaz-9hHMOqj0SyYbLhv3f-ckVbDX8DAAD__xscmKc)****We have just over one month.** And we have 250,000 children we're fighting to reach.Thank you!God Bless You and God Bless America,

In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress. | | | | Dear Friend, In just one month, we're taking our message straight to the Library of Congress. On September 26, I will kick off this year's "See You at the Library" Story Hours at America's Library in Washington, D.C.Then, just one week later, something truly incredible will happen. Christian parents and grandparents across America will walk into their local public libraries with their children and grandchildren.And in a matter of hours, hundreds of Story Hours will fill children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.This is our chance to bring God's truth into libraries across America and reach an entire generation of children. This year, honoring America's 250th birthday, our ambitious goal is to expand "See You at the Library Day" to reach 250,000 children.And we are just ONE MONTH away. Before then, I need you!The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host "Story Hours" has been overwhelming.But it's going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold "Story Hours" for 250,000 children.And with just over one month left, the clock is running out to fund the Story Hours we need to reach 250,000 children. Friend, America's children need to hear our message because today's "educators" and librarians are radicals! Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, radical activists have worked to turn our public libraries into vehicles for their values.But we can't just sit back and complain about it. We're countering those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And on October 3, a little boy or girl will stand up at their public library as straight and tall as they possibly can... ...as their right hand covers their heart, and they proudly pledge allegiance to our American flag.We'll teach them:Freedom Requires Courage.Great Blessings Require Great Sacrifice.IN GOD WE TRUST. And we hope to engrave those lessons on every child's heart at "See You at the Library Day."But first, we have to get the resources into the hands of the parents, grandparents, and patriots who are organizing these Story Hours.Your tax-deductible sponsorship gift helps send a "Story Hour Kit" to volunteers organizing "See You at the Library" events. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. That's enough to sponsor one entire "Story Hour Kit " yourself. Singlehandedly, you'll be helping us reach approximately 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. body:
A review of Vikram's August posts...

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mansharamani/vikram-update-august-17451811?e=93b2c2b824)
---

| | | | | |
# Mansharamani Musings
---
| | [](https://us.list-manage.com/WIMHcGN1A3i?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)During August, I wrote about restive youth around the world...and specifically about the cockroach revolution in India. Other topics that caught my attention included Guyana’s booming economy, the quantum computing revolution, our K-shaped economy, and the boom in humanoid robotics. I also had a chance to speak with Sanjiv Yajnik, President of Capital One’s auto finance effort, and Billy Webster, a successful entrepreneur who ran for Governor of South Carolina. Links to my writings and interviews are below...
Best wishes for a thought-filled September!_**
- Vikram**_

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/JQNap7aBT8W?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
| | **AUGUST 2, 2026**

A wave of youth-led protests has been sweeping the globe, and it is [unlike anything we’ve seen since the Arab Spring](https://us.list-manage.com/qn0WZbVhZaH?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). Over the past three years, Gen Z protesters have toppled governments, stormed parliaments, and forced presidents to flee their own palaces. [Bloomberg suggests the unrest is being driven by a generation “crushed by soaring rents and living costs and staring down a future where robots and AI threaten their jobs](https://us.list-manage.com/1Ad8NnQMuH7?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586).” The protests are leaderless, organized on TikTok and Discord, and spreading across three continents with a speed that has caught governments completely off guard.
Here’s the scorecard (so far): Sri Lanka (2022), Bangladesh (2024), Kenya (2024, 2026), Serbia (2024), Nepal (2025), Indonesia (2025), Morocco (2025), Philippines (2025), Madagascar (2025), Tanzania (2025)... see full post for details on these and others!
**And don’t forget about the United States.** That same generational frustration and economic anger are fueling the rise of democratic socialism and leading to the elections of far-left candidates across the country, most notably in New York City...
---
| [CLICK HERE TO CONTINUE READING](https://us.list-manage.com/EAtzHHtiKWj?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
---
|
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/9e1Miw8vGid?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
| | **AUGUST 9, 2026**

Let me tell you about the luckiest country on Earth, one most people have never even heard of. Guyana is a former British colony on the northern coast of South America with a population of **800,000 people** , fewer than Austin, Texas. In 2015, ExxonMobil was drilling in the waters off Georgetown, Guyana and struck oil. What they found was staggering: [over 11 billion barrels of recoverable resources](https://us.list-manage.com/XRTSiWe7SJb?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) in the Stabroek Block, one of the largest discoveries of the 21st century. In just 11 years, Guyana went from [zero to 903,000 barrels per day](https://us.list-manage.com/kqKb9VcHF4f?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), one of the fastest production ramp-ups in the history of global oil.
The numbers are staggering. Guyana has been and continues to be the [fastest-growing economy on Earth](https://us.list-manage.com/rId4tc2ViPn?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), with GDP growth of **43.6% in 2024, 19.3% in 2025, and a projected 16.2% in 2026**. It is now the [11th richest country in the world by GDP per capita](https://us.list-manage.com/tlooRBqXYTB?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). The government has taken in [$6.2 billion in oil revenues](https://us.list-manage.com/qsU1XfW2Nwp?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) as of late 2024, and this year’s annual revenue is projected to exceed $3 billion. A fifth offshore project, the [$12.7 billion Uaru development](https://us.list-manage.com/Ythwvq4HJM_?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), comes online this year, which will drive production past one million barrels per day. By 2030, Guyana could be pumping [1.9 million barrels per day](https://us.list-manage.com/oXV5squTOQ0?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), becoming South America’s second-largest producer behind Brazil (and ahead of Venezuela)....

| [CLICK HERE TO CONTINUE READING](https://us.list-manage.com/10SXpt__eLN?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
---
|
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/NQcDnF75P5U?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
| | **AUGUST 16, 2026**

The most dangerous weapon in the world doesn’t exist yet, but the damage it will cause may already be done. The weapon is quantum technology, which has the potential to disrupt almost every form of communication and the protection of secrets, especially when it comes to national security. And the worst part is it’s already too late to stop the damage it will do.
But first, a quick detour into the physics of quantum computing. Every computer you’ve ever used stores information in **bits** , tiny switches that are either 0 or 1. Every email, every photo, every encrypted military communication, is just a very long string of 0s and 1s that are processed very fast. Quantum computing is not just an incremental improvement in speed, it’s fundamentally different. Instead of bits, it uses **qubits** , which can be 0, 1, or (and this is the part that makes my brain hurt) _both at the same time_. A qubit exists in both states simultaneously until you measure it. (This is where Schrödinger’s cat comes from—the cat is both alive and dead until you open the box.) While my PhD physicist friends may say I’m oversimplifying the difference, I’ve come to think of quantum computing as probabilistic and traditional computing as binary...

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/103keZl_HYh?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
| | **AUGUST 22, 2026**

According to the headlines, the American economy is doing fine. Not great, not terrible, but fine. [GDP grew 2.0% in Q1 2026](https://us.list-manage.com/1BdE2QQdTWy?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). Employment seems stable-ish. Inflation, while still above the Fed’s 2% target, looks like its moderating. The [CBO projects continued economic expansion](https://us.list-manage.com/19GbUuA0UHB?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) through the end of the year. Consumer spending is holding up, particularly at the upper end. The stock market is near all-time highs. Corporate earnings are strong, especially in tech.
Yet despite this news, most Americans are worried. Consumer confidence is far from ebullient. And the US economy is shed more jobs than it created in July. I’ve spent a career looking past headlines and connecting seemingly irrelevant and disparate dots. And the mosaic I’m putting together is forming a deeply concerning image...
---
| [CLICK HERE TO CONTINUE READING](https://us.list-manage.com/EepC6emis0g?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
---
|
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/165l4vVuzOG?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)
| | **AUGUST 29, 2026**

Regular readers know that I have written quite a bit about AI and the breathtaking speed at which it has grown. Dario Amodei, the CEO of Anthropic, [described the trajectory](https://us.list-manage.com/PM4fP8az9D6?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) as heading toward “a country of geniuses in a datacenter.” It sure feels like the future will be filled with machines that can already outthink most humans in most domains. But it’s not just intellectually where the machines are surpassing us. It’s physically too.
Being outperformed by a machine is nothing new. After all, cars and tractors and factories full of equipment have been doing so for centuries. But the development of humanoid robots, machines built to resemble humans that walk on two legs with two moving arms, has been advancing at accelerating rate. Further, the humanoids are increasingly becoming _autonomous_.
All of this was on full display during the recent [World Humanoid Robot Games](https://us.list-manage.com/dIEVkYGU7OC?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) in Beijing. Held at the National Speed Skating Oval, the very venue the PRC built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the competition brought together [over 2,000 humanoid robots from 666 teams across 16 countries](https://us.list-manage.com/ryWffqGFrmc?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). The robots competed in 51 events, from sprinting to soccer and table tennis to kickboxing. [**More than 40% of the events required fully autonomous operation**](https://us.list-manage.com/aQ1PCTqA5aN?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). And by fully autonomous, I mean that there were no human operators with joysticks, remote controls, or intervention of any kind. These robots operated on their own...

body:
A catastrophic vulnerability has been found in MAGA's death star, and we are about to blow it wide open.
| | | | | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001mjwD57otuKJpsuR1E4qCuLGL6ql789d3bOFT8IeZh26RnYVUk0eh7V3tRozcS9U-gdJGCBXFyl6vUq32BFsyvsvjhpz66RAngqD4llkuri0km7vFxv5rUeSJdUI5WLQcetMSWBvjxiQTo2hd9tYI8NnPXGUjB_X2RETWHwQe1AKkl1y86kwg9rHCEt3FyiyWgAXHOm-uOn3dC__JxqusoPiknelt1WrZ&c=w88mh4fOfSO3kmybPcL1GVX3sKzxEnhc3oJxanCX0R9MKWyrOm7H1g==&ch=3ZpiqiejWMa1gMaJQEnKMDN_GSsVg8rx7f4u4Dn8rajtpcmTGzyLLw==)
---
| Peter,
Louisiana is MAGA's death star. It is the place where they test their most policies before firing them off at the rest of the country.
This summer alone, they canceled an ongoing election under a fake "state of emergency" and eliminated one of our majority-Black Democratic districts.
They passed a bill forcing homeless people into indentured servitude. They criminalized abortion. They deployed the National Guard into our streets. They tortured immigrants at the Winn Correctional Center in North Louisiana.
But a rebellion is brewing in the Bayou.
A catastrophic vulnerability has been found in MAGA's death star, and we are about to blow it wide open. Trump's approval rating in the state is underwater. Voters are fed up with the foreign wars, an economy on the brink of collapse, and National Guard and ICE storm troopers patrolling our own streets.
The rebellion has already struck. On May 16th, Democrats turned out in record numbers and delivered a blow that blindsided MAGA, sinking every single one of Governor Landry's amendments by 20 points or more.
Now Democrat Jamie Davis just outraised MAGA candidate Julia Letlow last fundraising quarter and is statistically tied with her in the latest poll on the U.S. Senate race.

Patriot,

You hear it every time you turn on the news... _" Donald Trump wants to be King." "Donald Trump is a dictator." "Donald Trump is a Nazi."_

But actually, it's President Trump's leftist foes who are _the true authoritarians_.

These aren't saviors of democracy. _**They 're Marxists**_.
Consider Zohran Mamdani, the newest hero of the Left, who pledged in his inaugural address that he would replace individualism with the "warmth of collectivism."

And Cea Weaver, whom Mamdani appointed to oversee housing in New York, has said she wants to "transition" away from private property.
Increasingly, they proudly call for outright socialism!

**This is an alarming wake-up call. A warning to Americans across the country to fight for our constitutional rights and our free-market system. **

Because if the radical left gets their way, these things will be gone forever...

I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftists who want to tear our country down.

I know you won't either!

I'm doing everything I can to rally our fellow freedom-lovers to the fight, through my books, my radio show, and my TV show.

_**But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation.**_

Landmark is here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism...in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution.

Landmark Legal Foundation battles the Left in court. Their top-notch team of lawyers files "friend of the court" briefs to back up major cases against government abuses. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and **help convince judges to do the right thing.**

My friends at Landmark fight hard to save our country. And now, I hope you'll join their fight.

I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?
