clean_body: | | | | | Friend, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Friend, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Friend... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Friend -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... It closes for good. That's what's at stake. Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- while it still matters. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. I need you to hear this clearly... Charlie Kirk wasn't just dreaming big when he called me last year about Club America's progress. He was warning us: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. Look around. Club America may be in 13% of high schools... But in the other 87%? There is no pushback against the Left. No one telling those kids the truth. Just a Leftist pipeline -- from classroom... to belief... to voting booth. And once that pipeline is complete... It 's over. Friend, this is one of the last places a patriot like you can stop it before it 's too late to save our country. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will. There's still time to turn this country around... and this is one of the few ways we can actually do it -- one student, one school, one chapter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: Donald Trump wants to make voting harder
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
It's never going to stop, not unless we end it at the ballot box. Peter,

Voting should be simple: If you're eligible to vote, you should be able to make your voice heard. _Period._ But right now, **that fundamental right is under attack.**

Donald Trump and his allies are targeting mail-in voting, and now, battles over how Americans cast their ballots are reaching the Supreme Court.

These attacks aren't just about changing election rules, Peter. They're about making it harder for people to participate in our democracy and have a say in the decisions that shape their lives.

**Our democracy is strongest when every American can exercise their fundamental right to vote.** Wesley has always fought to protect that right and ensure that the voices of everyday people are heard — and he isn't about to stop now.

## **The Surging Numbers: Why Labor Day Weekend is the Ultimate Political Alarm Clock**
Labor Day weekend is here, and in national campaign strategy, that means one thing: the political season is officially kicking into high gear.
The media loves to spend this time of year focusing on cable news noise, ad buys, and political posturing.
They're distracted by the noise, and they're missing the momentum.
The latest voter enthusiasm numbers from Echelon Insights speak for themselves:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bc051f47-b360-4148-b862-693af57094a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

In August 2025, Democratic voter enthusiasm stood at 64%, while Republican enthusiasm lagged behind at 48%.
That was a 16-point enthusiam gap.
Fast forward to today:
* Democrats: 67% (+3)
* Republicans: 63% (+15)

A 15-point surge for Republicans.
That isn't a statistical fluke.
That is a grassroots movement waking up just as the country enters into the unofficial kickoff of the fall election cycle.

Doug Burgum is building Trump’s Arch

| | | | Peter, **Yesterday, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced that the administration is firing up the excavators to begin construction on a massive, 250-foot "Triumphal Arch" right at the entrance to Arlington National Cemetery.** They are ramming this gold-adorned monument to vanity forward without final planning approval, without required historic preservation reviews, and while actively ignoring a lawsuit from Vietnam War veterans who are begging them not to destroy the solemn sightlines of our nation's most hallowed ground. Burgum doesn't care. He took to social media to brag about the excavation, **proving once again that he views every sacred inch of American soil as nothing more than a personal playground for the elite.** [**Will you pitch in $25 today to our rapid-response war chest to help us expose Burgum’s corruption and hold the politicians enabling him accountable?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/LzPvvHw12C57_EXjTpsw8Q~~/AAUS1hA~/rERl1ws9tkmaORzzF078r5zi2EdvZ8OSgzTDfb_2Uuheyck5A6977yqii1c3hPFlMC2GBn7sm_F3V1oxHg4951CDhq96yuLcjYk2bPi5ZE22geTuAVOnov-R-7xGBAS6BtS8HrlSwYz_l2z4JKjGKszP0WSCabTIEjp3xAimOOsb-vB1pVcrSFiTyOtNf8pPClxs2tVaw7uVBMVZQOcFXGcggadPEZJZMZecRJIbyi6v4wXQ6MOk_k76mrA9QZI1) We shouldn't be surprised by this un-American arrogance. The profound disrespect Doug Burgum is showing to our veterans and our national cemetery is the exact same disrespect he shows to our public lands every single day. This is the man who looked at the American public and declared that our wild spaces are simply "America's balance sheet"—**meant to be liquidated for mining, grazing, and timber.** He is the architect behind handing over prime, untouched federal land in the Crazy Mountains to his billionaire buddies at the ultra-exclusive Yellowstone Club, where he conveniently owns a $22 million condo. He is the one rubber-stamping backdoor deals to bulldoze gas-powered AI data centers into the Nevada desert, bypassing environmental reviews and locking out the public. To Doug Burgum, whether it is the hallowed ground of Arlington National Cemetery or the pristine backcountry of the American West, if it isn't making a billionaire richer or stroking a politician's ego, it is useless. At Public Land Warriors, we are funding a targeted, inescapable digital ad blitz to make sure every voter knows exactly how little respect these politicians have for our veterans, our wild spaces, and our laws. [**Will you chip in $10, $25, or $50 today to fund the backlash and ensure they pay for this arrogance with their jobs?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/c4VcVBygEIbFDrerXK94hA~~/AAUS1hA~/GYp4cM5Fl8hGdqXbDuzvtnYDGU0l1KzUlcCNlNowB1gJYBv29baeJgMetA-3cNmB9v-c2YbGEHWlwhOKX-QAPzx_jT3PpogQ5FIVJoIRsfhQ4AqcYE0vSFlLmgzNXFAxsOEnULiSqcuCpGzq3MYUYB8xMyTmISUO5vOfO4Fl8fGGrekARji143VOwTIUJM59xLNurKkcAv33YOrbLeSyjd1j7r_cbWkukpA9G5fNiU2nSO2oJshK1CiLWG0CuMXL) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/c4VcVBygEIbFDrerXK94hA~~/AAUS1hA~/GYp4cM5Fl8hGdqXbDuzvtnYDGU0l1KzUlcCNlNowB1gJYBv29baeJgMetA-3cNmB9v-c2YbGEHWlwhOKX-QAPzx_jT3PpogQ5FIVJoIRsfhQ4AqcYE0vSFlLmgzNXFAxsOEnULiSqcuCpGzq3MYUYB8xMyTmISUO5vOfO4Fl8fGGrekARji143VOwTIUJM59xLNurKkcAv33YOrbLeSyjd1j7r_cbWkukpA9G5fNiU2nSO2oJshK1CiLWG0CuMXL) ** They think they can do whatever they want to our land. name: Friends of Maria Jukic
subject: Got a yard? Maria's got a sign for you. 💙
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Maria Jukic
body:
From our Ashtabula kickoff to the fight for Ohio communities, here’s what’s happening.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/hrYqAzeEQJS?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Dear friend,
**The momentum is building.** Across our district, neighbors are coming together, sharing their concerns, and joining a campaign focused on listening, solving problems, and creating a better future for Ohio. Here’s what’s happening this week — and how you can be part of it.
---
|
---
|
---
| |
# The Great Geauga County Fair
---
| |
Labor Day weekend is almost here, and I’m looking forward to spending it with people across Ohio’s 14th District.
This Saturday, I’ll be at the **Great Geauga County Fair** , one of Ohio’s great traditions and the state’s oldest continuous county fair. For generations, the fair has brought together families, farmers, small businesses, and neighbors from across Geauga County and beyond.
I hope you’ll stop by, say hello, and introduce yourself. **I want to hear what’s happening in your community, what’s working, and where you need help.**

---
|
---
|
---
| |
# Ashtabula Local Food Festival
---
| | Maria will be walking around the Harbor this Sunday, enjoying the local food, and talking with people along the way.
Join her in exploring the restaurants, wineries, breweries, and shops that make Historic Ashtabula Harbor such a special part of our community.
If you see Maria, stop and say hello! She’d love to meet you, hear what’s on your mind, and talk about what matters to you and your community.
---
|
---
| |
# Election Matters
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Bg2MyjWcsUv?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| | **Ashtabula County Campaign Kickoff** Maria Jukic officially kicked off her Ashtabula County campaign with a community event at the Jefferson Community Recreation Center, where she shared her vision for Ohio’s 14th Congressional District and discussed issues including affordability, healthcare, artificial intelligence, data centers, and restoring trust in government.During the event, Maria emphasized her commitment to representing everyday Americans rather than special interests.

The event also highlighted Maria’s concerns about the rapid expansion of AI data centers and the need for responsible regulation that protects local communities while encouraging innovation.**Read the full story in the Star Beacon** :
[https://www.starbeacon.com/news/congressional-candidate-stops-in-jefferson/article_8bb63314-ce09-474b-8499-d594c3b3c53b.html](https://us.list-manage.com/hbzM6DI_BeA?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)

---
|
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/8qrRXQci3Ky?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| |
Maria joined healthcare advocates, local leaders, and community members in Warren to support efforts to restore local hospital services for Trumbull County residents.During the event, Maria spoke about the importance of protecting access to quality healthcare and ensuring families don’t have to travel farther or wait longer to receive the care they need. Drawing on her 24 years of healthcare experience, she emphasized that access to healthcare is a community issue that affects patients, families, workers, and local economies.WKBN interviewed Maria during the rally and highlighted the community’s call to reopen Trumbull County Hospital.
**“The government needs to do something to help address communities like this that don’t have enough access to healthcare services.”**
– Maria Jukic**Watch/read the full WKBN story:**
[ https://www.wkbn.com/news/local-news/warren-news/organizations-advocate-for-reopening-of-trumbull-county-hospital/](https://us.list-manage.com/j7JXgFsHakW?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
---
|
---
| |
# Calling all donors.

**Any amount helps.** $10, $25, $50 — every contribution helps put Maria Jukic on the field and keep this campaign moving forward.
---
|
---
| | Every small town in Ohio knows this: the team plays, but the boosters make it possible. Somebody bought the uniforms. Somebody paid for the school bus.Our boosters buy yard signs, postcards, and gas money.
Join our booster club 💙
---
| [SUPPORT MARIA](https://us.list-manage.com/V1aWrl9hXEI?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
---
|
---
| |
# Got a yard? We’ve got a sign.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/SuBKixliLYU?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| [Request a Yard Sign](https://us.list-manage.com/oWvwYaCcs8R?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
---
|
---
| | **THIS WEEK’S MISSION,
should you choose to accept it.**
Forward this email to five people who should know about our campaign.
That's it. No skydiving required.
Every conversation starts somewhere. Let it start with you.

---

News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong.

---
| Letter from the Chair
---
| Fellow Nebraska Republicans,
Time for the rubber to meet the road
Today we are 59 days from the November 3 election and 24 days from the first early ballots hitting mailboxes.
That is not a calendar note. That is a deadline.
Are you knocking doors? Making calls? Putting out yard signs? Giving? Volunteering with a campaign? If the answer is "someone else will," that someone else may not show up.
Republicans have a record to run on. Democrats would rather you forget it. Here is what changed after 2024--and what would have been different if they had won.
A sovereign border again. Catch-and-release is over. The Trump administration has reported month after month of zero Border Patrol releases at the southwest border, and illegal crossings have collapsed from the Biden-era surge.
Illegal immigration in reverse. The best current household-survey analysis shows the foreign-born population down about 2.9 million since January 2025, with the illegal population down an estimated 2.3 million. Net migration turned negative--the first time in decades. That is not a talking point. That is a country taking itself back.
Safer streets. FBI data show violent crime dropped about 9-10 percent in 2025, the largest one-year decline since national estimates began in the 1930s. The murder rate fell to 4.1 per 100,000, tying the mid-1950s low.
Tax relief that stuck. The One Big Beautiful Bill locked in the 2017 tax cuts, kept the larger standard deduction, and strengthened the Child Tax Credit. It also created new relief for tips, overtime, and seniors. That is money in the pockets of working families--not another D.C. lecture about "paying their fair share.
Fraud is being aggressively pursued. The Justice Department created a Fraud Division to handle multi-agency and multi-district cases targeting government programs, benefits, and private victims. Vice President JD Vance chairs the White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud in programs run jointly with states.
Rebuilding in America again. Companies have announced trillions of dollars in U.S. investment. The point is simple: more factories, more energy, more medicines made here--not in countries that do not wish us well.
Trade moving our way. Through July, the U.S. goods-and-services trade deficit is down nearly 30 percent from the same stretch in 2025. The agricultural deficit is being cut sharply from last year's blowout. USTR recently said the ag deficit was a little over $15 billion Jan-July 2026, versus a much larger 2025 gap of $44 billion. American farmers should not have to subsidize other countries' markets.
Energy dominance. Production and exports are at historic strength. The center of gravity is the Gulf of America, not the Persian Gulf. The United States is producing more liquid energy than China and Russia combined. That is national security with a paycheck attached.
Nuclear is back. After four decades of "no new nuclear", America is restarting plants, financing new reactors, and putting advanced designs through real tests. Cheap, reliable power is how you reduce energy costs and win the AI and manufacturing race.
Voters--not bureaucrats--are in charge. The Supreme Court has broken the old model of "independent" agencies and unelected bureaucrats that answered to no one. The federal workforce is down sharply including the civilian executive workforce being the lowest in 60 years. Unelected staffers do not get a veto over elections.
Parents first. The Education Freedom Tax Credit is the first nationwide federal school-choice scholarship tax credit for states that opt in. Trump Accounts give children a stake in America's future, including a $1,000 federal seed for eligible newborns.
Common sense restored. DEI is out of the federal government and merit-based is back. The Hyde Amendment and Mexico City Policy are being enforced so American taxpayers do not have to pay for abortions. The United States government again recognizes two sexes: male and female. Taxpayers are no longer underwriting the chemical and surgical sterilization of children.
Strength abroad. NATO allies are being told to pay more for their own defense. Chinese influence is being pushed out of the Panama Canal, Venezuela, and Cuba. America has used leverage to force ceasefires and settlements in eight conflicts spanning four continents that other administrations ignored or tolerated for decades.
A serious military. The recruiting crisis is over and a warrior ethos restored. Young Americans are joining again in droves. Golden Dome--the first serious nationwide missile shield of its kind--has been launched and funded.
That is the contrast. Open borders or a country. Record crime or record drops. Tax hikes or tax cuts. Weakness or peace through strength.
None of it holds if we stay home in November.
Do something this week. Pick a campaign. Take a turf list. Write a check. Put a sign in the yard. Take a neighbor to early vote when ballots drop.
Fifty-nine days. The other side is not taking a break. Neither should we.
Onward to November. Together We Win!
In Liberty and in Truth,
Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair | Fellow Nebraska Republicans, Time for the rubber to meet the road Today we are 59 days from the November 3 election and 24 days from the first early ballots hitting mailboxes. That is not a calendar note. That is a deadline. Are you knocking doors? Making calls? Putting out yard signs? Giving? Volunteering with a campaign? If the answer is "someone else will," that someone else may not show up. Republicans have a record to run on. Democrats would rather you forget it. Here is what changed after 2024--and what would have been different if they had won. A sovereign border again. Catch-and-release is over. The Trump administration has reported month after month of zero Border Patrol releases at the southwest border, and illegal crossings have collapsed from the Biden-era surge. Illegal immigration in reverse. The best current household-survey analysis shows the foreign-born population down about 2.9 million since January 2025, with the illegal population down an estimated 2.3 million. Net migration turned negative--the first time in decades. That is not a talking point. That is a country taking itself back. Safer streets. FBI data show violent crime dropped about 9-10 percent in 2025, the largest one-year decline since national estimates began in the 1930s. The murder rate fell to 4.1 per 100,000, tying the mid-1950s low. Tax relief that stuck. The One Big Beautiful Bill locked in the 2017 tax cuts, kept the larger standard deduction, and strengthened the Child Tax Credit. It also created new relief for tips, overtime, and seniors. That is money in the pockets of working families--not another D.C. lecture about "paying their fair share. Fraud is being aggressively pursued. The Justice Department created a Fraud Division to handle multi-agency and multi-district cases targeting government programs, benefits, and private victims. Vice President JD Vance chairs the White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud in programs run jointly with states. Rebuilding in America again. Companies have announced trillions of dollars in U.S. investment. The point is simple: more factories, more energy, more medicines made here--not in countries that do not wish us well. Trade moving our way. Through July, the U.S. goods-and-services trade deficit is down nearly 30 percent from the same stretch in 2025. The agricultural deficit is being cut sharply from last year's blowout. USTR recently said the ag deficit was a little over $15 billion Jan-July 2026, versus a much larger 2025 gap of $44 billion. American farmers should not have to subsidize other countries' markets. Energy dominance. Production and exports are at historic strength. The center of gravity is the Gulf of America, not the Persian Gulf. The United States is producing more liquid energy than China and Russia combined. That is national security with a paycheck attached. Nuclear is back. After four decades of "no new nuclear", America is restarting plants, financing new reactors, and putting advanced designs through real tests. Cheap, reliable power is how you reduce energy costs and win the AI and manufacturing race. Voters--not bureaucrats--are in charge. The Supreme Court has broken the old model of "independent" agencies and unelected bureaucrats that answered to no one. The federal workforce is down sharply including the civilian executive workforce being the lowest in 60 years. Unelected staffers do not get a veto over elections. Parents first. The Education Freedom Tax Credit is the first nationwide federal school-choice scholarship tax credit for states that opt in. Trump Accounts give children a stake in America's future, including a $1,000 federal seed for eligible newborns. Common sense restored. DEI is out of the federal government and merit-based is back. The Hyde Amendment and Mexico City Policy are being enforced so American taxpayers do not have to pay for abortions. The United States government again recognizes two sexes: male and female. Taxpayers are no longer underwriting the chemical and surgical sterilization of children. Strength abroad. NATO allies are being told to pay more for their own defense. Chinese influence is being pushed out of the Panama Canal, Venezuela, and Cuba. America has used leverage to force ceasefires and settlements in eight conflicts spanning four continents that other administrations ignored or tolerated for decades. A serious military. The recruiting crisis is over and a warrior ethos restored. Young Americans are joining again in droves. Golden Dome--the first serious nationwide missile shield of its kind--has been launched and funded. That is the contrast. Open borders or a country. Record crime or record drops. Tax hikes or tax cuts. Weakness or peace through strength. None of it holds if we stay home in November. Do something this week. Pick a campaign. Take a turf list. Write a check. Put a sign in the yard. Take a neighbor to early vote when ballots drop. Fifty-nine days. The other side is not taking a break. Neither should we. Onward to November. Together We Win! body:
#

Friends --
As I was starting my day today, I couldn’t help but reflect on how far we’ve come.
In 2013, I delivered remarks before the Senate Judiciary Committee’s first hearing on gun violence.
This was one of my first appearances after being shot at point blank range during a constituent event two years prior. It also came just weeks after the tragic shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School.
I had a simple message for the committee:**We must do something.**
**[Please watch. It’ll only take 78 seconds.](https://go.giffords.org/go/68667?t=1&akid=11785%2E3935704%2E8xRiil)**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/68667?t=2&akid=11785%2E3935704%2E8xRiil)
If you are tired of living in a country where gun violence is the #1 killer of children and teens — and you are ready to do something about it — then I am asking you to join me in this fight.
Thank you.
Gabby Giffords

Please, take a second to read this...
As a victim of political violence, Gabby Giffords has led the fight to save more lives from gun violence for more than a decade, but she can’t do it alone.
If everyone reading this donated just $17, we'd have the resources to pass commonsense gun safety legislation across the country. But not everyone gives — making it even more important for people who care and understand the stakes of our struggle to pitch in what they can.
**If $17 seems worth it to you to change our gun laws in order to make our communities safer from gun violence, we're asking you to contribute to GIFFORDS PAC today.**
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/61660?c0=giff-em-q32026.QDXtSy&refcode=em260904-1-b&t=3&akid=11785%2E3935704%2E8xRiil)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=11785%2E3935704%2E8xRiil) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

Senate Republicans recently announced that they have no plans to spend party money to help conservative Ken Paxton win the U.S. Senate race in Texas. "We in the Senate don't have the money budgeted for Texas. We need help from the president," said Senator John Kennedy (R-LA). Republican Leader John Thune (R-SD) later confirmed the plan to abandon Paxton financially and deflected responsibility to the president. "I'm hoping the White House will become engaged; Texas is an incredibly expensive state," Thune said. What makes this so infuriating is that the Senate GOP spent over $100 million attacking Ken Paxton in the Republican primary. **They had plenty of money to spend on Texas when they were trying to defeat a conservative, but when it comes to defeating a Marxist like James Talarico, they’ve got nothing.** You would think that since they spent so much against the party's eventual nominee, they would feel some obligation to help him now. **This race is competitive because they hurt Paxton in the primary. It should be on them, not President Trump, to clean up their mess. You break it, you own it.** Sadly, that's not going to happen. You may hear party leaders say they "hope" Ken Paxton wins and they "hope" President Trump helps him, but they have closed their wallets and are quietly rooting for him to lose. They don't want another conservative in the Senate who will hold them accountable, and they would love to tell everyone that Ken Paxton was a bad candidate who cost them the majority, even though they're the ones who kneecapped and left him for dead. **TAKE ACTION** **Conservatives are right to be mad about this, but being mad won't change it. Nothing will do more to defeat the feckless GOP establishment than electing true conservative fighters to the U.S. Senate. This is how we must respond. We must win even with the odds stacked against us. We do it because it's our legacy. We love this country and don't give up; we don't back down. On June 29, 2024, Representative Julia Letlow (R‐LA) signed a mutual nondisclosure agreement with Laidley LLC, a shell company owned by Meta Platforms. The agreement gave her access to confidential information about Meta's planned "Hyperion" data center in Richland Parish, Louisiana--a project valued at roughly $50 billion. Within months of signing that NDA, Letlow began purchasing shares of Meta and Nvidia (the semiconductor company whose chips power Meta's data centers). On January 31, 2025, she sold some of her Nvidia holdings and bought additional Meta stock; she then sold portions of her Meta position on February 7 and again on July 2, 2025. She did not disclose any of these trades until August 11, 2025--more than a month after her final sale and long after the statutory window had closed.
This sequence is not merely a procedural footnote. It is a case study in why the Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge (STOCK) Act of 2012, despite its broad intent, is failing to stop the very behavior it condemns.

His administration canceled $645 million in clean energy and climate-related grants for Minnesota, part of a larger effort targeting states that voted Democratic in 2024.
That means money meant to help upgrade the electric grid, lower energy costs, and support local clean energy projects was ripped away because Trump wanted to score political points.

Local leaders need partners who will help them build for the future — not a president willing to pull the rug out from under them because he lost a state.

name: Breaking News:
subject: MAGA’s gerrymandered map struck down by MO supreme court
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DEFEND OUR COURTS, NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE
body:
Justice was served in Missouri as the state supreme court justices sided with the people and the law—exactly what we fight for at Defend Our Courts.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vTrt-OknH91o3zlLcp9cP7DgPzyOtkcHdJzMUwM23bXpaMnyp7vU5rQGY6XYZpqyKNqDlT9cm7MlAlY34tbNyU-iPv064TX-vqO9N90PyjE66LBwF52W7DHK-kDAGbF0tUIZjp7i0bptHY0j6K_dUrbQhkfcrRioV_OqYBUDcegkf7cgoN2DMXvSI1CPAnSDgU8xOv8qJWKcI8p7SM41NSr4DpTzMOEkfGjJeWCRoPk=&c=nvgpsFb6AWzjMecPYVNFt6OxRs0FbLec9GoUtQOXPFJ6rcLpURS7NA==&ch=WW4YMuSFCFCkjCw1NR7YSoyhWBLJYPUxlEcvcqyNFS4YpuU7cAMSBQ==)
---
|
Peter,
The Missouri Supreme Court just ruled that the gerrymandered map that MAGA rushed through at Donald Trump's behest last year must NOT be used for the November midterm election.
The MO GOP tried to force a new map on voters that eliminated one of only two Black Democratic members of Congress, Rep. Emanuel Cleaver. Under the now-suspended MAGA map, Cleaver's Kansas City-area district went from solidly Dem to blood red Republican overnight.
The justices on the MO Supreme Court just struck down the use of those maps after pro-democracy advocates submitted over 300,000 valid signatures to put Trump's illegal map up for a vote on the ballot in November.
MAGA's scheme to steal a seat in Missouri and ignore the will of the people got Trump's attention, who called the ruling "horrible, ridiculous, and unConstitutional" and used the court's ruling as an opportunity to lay the groundwork for federal interference, saying the "Election Process, as usual, is being disturbed in America!"
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vTrt-OknH91o3zlLcp9cP7DgPzyOtkcHdJzMUwM23bXpaMnyp7vU5rQGY6XYZpqyKNqDlT9cm7MlAlY34tbNyU-iPv064TX-vqO9N90PyjE66LBwF52W7DHK-kDAGbF0tUIZjp7i0bptHY0j6K_dUrbQhkfcrRioV_OqYBUDcegkf7cgoN2DMXvSI1CPAnSDgU8xOv8qJWKcI8p7SM41NWaCviI1ktopZUve4Dj9bvk=&c=nvgpsFb6AWzjMecPYVNFt6OxRs0FbLec9GoUtQOXPFJ6rcLpURS7NA==&ch=WW4YMuSFCFCkjCw1NR7YSoyhWBLJYPUxlEcvcqyNFS4YpuU7cAMSBQ==)
---

The court's ruling suspends MAGA's map and orders the state to use the 2022 map for the November election, essentially restoring Rep. Cleaver's district and taking away a seat that MAGA had boasted about stealing since late last year.
But two MAGA extremists, MO's Secretary of State and Attorney General, have already said they will appeal directly to the United States Supreme Court, where it is a coin toss whether the Roberts Court will respect the ruling or interfere on Trump's behalf.
No matter what happens, justice was served in Missouri as the state supreme court justices sided with the people and the law--exactly what we fight for at Defend Our Courts.
This ruling is a perfect example of why the work we do is so crucial. We're working to expand the firewall of state Supreme Courts nationwide and to turn out voters in the states with the House and Senate races that will decide who holds the power to investigate.
But our main job right now is to make this November's blue wave too big to rig.
[Trump is going to try just about anything to cling to power after November. But he can't steal an election that his party loses by historic margins. The goal of this bill is simple and clear: > > Requires Proof of Citizenship: It stops non-citizens from voting by requiring real proof of U.S. citizenship to register. > > Cleans Up Voter Lists: It forces states to clear non-citizens off voter roles. > > Holds Officials Accountable: It sets strict penalties for election officials who break the rules. Yet, even though we need secure elections, the bill is stuck in the Senate. As Senate Majority Leader, Senator John Thune has the power to set the calendar and schedule the vote. Instead of using his power to pass this bill, leadership is letting the clock run out. | Elections are right around the corner, and we are out of time for games. If the Senate does not act now, our election system stays open to big risks when we can least afford it. We need leaders who treat election rules as a top priority today, not something to worry about later. | Paid for by Next250 ©2026 Next250. All Rights Reserved.

body:
I’d really appreciate it if you opened this email

_** Together, we were victorious in 2024, but as we head into the midterms, we will need to work twice as hard to maintain our Republican majority and continue providing President Trump with the fuel he needs to Make America Great Again.
Can I count on you again, Peter?

As Lyons Township Clerk Elyse Hoffenberg faces growing scrutiny over her after-hours kiss with Bridgeview Mayor Steven Landek, a neighboring Democratic Party leader is giving the Cook County Board candidate a prominent platform Tuesday night.

According to a Democratic event flyer, newly elected Lemont Township Democratic Committeeman Brendon Stark and the Lemont Democrats are hosting a “Meet & Greet” from 6:00 to 8:00 pm at Pollyanna Brewing Company in Lemont.

| | | | | | Peter,

**This is the final stretch, and we need all New Hampshire patriots to join us on the ground this weekend!**

Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire is hosting a Weekend of Action to mobilize voters and get our liberty champions over the finish line next Tuesday, September 8th.

We will be knocking doors in Hudson, Moultonborough, and Raymond this weekend. If you are available to join us, pick an event below and let us know you’re coming!
**DAY OF ACTION EVENT #1**

🗓️ **Date** : Saturday, September 5🕙 **Time** : 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM📍 **Location** : Friendly Red’s Tavern, 48 Lowell Rd, Hudson, NH 03051
🗳️ **In support of** : Adam Haverstock and Ted Trost
📝 **Note** : Lunch provided for volunteers. No experience needed, and all drivers are welcome. [Click here to RSVP today](https://us.list-manage.com/X20m0sPCHx1?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70).

**DAY OF ACTION EVENT #2

** 🗓️ **Date** : Saturday, September 5🕙 **Time** : 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM📍 **Location** : Kraine Meadow Park, 20 Playground Dr, Moultonborough, NH 03254
🗳️ **In support of** : Tammy Garthwaite, Colin Mitchell, and George Mottram
📝 **Note** : No experience needed, and all drivers are welcome. No need to RSVP. Reply directly to this email to let us know you’re coming!

**DAY OF ACTION EVENT #3**

🗓️ **Date** : Sunday, September 6🕙 **Time** : 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM📍 **Location** : Raymond Public Parking Lot, 2 Horse Shed Rd, Raymond, NH 03077
🗳️ **In support of** : Sen. Keith Murphy and Raymond Liberty Republicans (Mike Drago, Cindy Bennett, and Brian Nadeau)
📝 **Note** : No experience needed, and all drivers are welcome. No need to RSVP. Reply directly to this email to let us know you’re coming!

| | **The primary election is next Tuesday, September 8th.**

We can’t afford to sit on the sidelines and hope for the best. Primary elections are often decided by just a few votes, so we need every patriot in New Hampshire to make their voices heard and get out and vote on Election Day!

**Here’s how you can take our champions over the finish line on Election Day:**
➡️**RSVP to knock doors** this weekend to help get out the vote!

➡️ **Make a plan to vote on Tuesday, September 8th** , and vote for our endorsed Pledge Signers (if they’re on your ballot)

➡️ **Spread the word** by talking to friends, family, and neighbors in the district!

Thank you for standing with Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire

Let’s finish strong on Election Day!

We look forward to seeing you this weekend,

But that only works if the people we send to Washington put us first, and tell the truth. That's the job. Maggie does that work better than anyone. She swore an oath to the Constitution as a Navy intelligence officer, and she kept it last year when she said plainly that our servicemembers follow lawful orders, and lawful orders only. For that, the President threatened her and tried to have her indicted. She did not back down. They failed, and they will always fail. But the fight for this seat is just beginning. NH-02 is pivotal, and they know it. If Republicans defeat Maggie, they have a path to flip the House, and we lose the last real check on this president. == If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | == | == | == | == | == | == Thank you, Ken Burns | | Paid for by Maggie for Congress == * Maggie Goodlander has dedicated her life to public service, from staffing U.S. Senators, to clerking at the Supreme Court, to working in the White House. Thanks to dedicated grassroots donors, we’re able to help elect pro-voter candidates through targeted voter outreach, financial support, technical assistance, volunteer mobilization, and close coordination with coalition partners.
And just in the past year, we’ve helped deliver big wins, including:
* A political earthquake in Georgia: Democrats won both Public Service Commission seats by historic +25 point margins in 2025’s statewide elections — in a battleground state where races are usually decided by a few thousand votes.
* Eight victories in competitive Georgia municipal races where local leadership directly shapes voting access decisions.
* Flipping a critical Cobb County Commission seat to restore a 3-2 Democratic majority and put pro-democracy leadership back in charge of overseeing the County’s Board of Elections — with direct implications for election administration and voter access.
* Flipping Georgia’s State House District 121, which Donald Trump won by 12 points in 2024. Now we’re one step closer to flipping the State House this year, which requires 10 pickups — fewer than the number Democrats flipped in 2018.
* Working in a coalition to help add Democratic seats to the Mississippi legislature for the first time in decades and flip nine local seats across strategically selected cities and key jurisdictions — including the election of the first Black mayors of Horn Lake and Brookhaven.

The work we did in 2025 positioned Fair Fight to scale in 2026. We’ve tested new tools, deepened partnerships, expanded our reach, and proven we can win even when the odds are stacked against us. **We’ve got a proven model. And every dollar we’re able to put towards this winning approach in 2026 will help ensure free and fair elections for years to come.**

And with special elections and potential runoffs happening nearly every month this year leading up to November, the financial support we receive today will help inform how much we can invest for the rest of 2026. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- Thanks to dedicated grassroots donors, we’re able to help elect pro-voter candidates through targeted voter outreach, financial support, technical assistance, volunteer mobilization, and close coordination with coalition partners. And just in the past year, we’ve helped deliver big wins, including: A political earthquake in Georgia: Democrats won both Public Service Commission seats by historic +25 point margins in 2025’s statewide elections — in a battleground state where races are usually decided by a few thousand votes. Eight victories in competitive Georgia municipal races where local leadership directly shapes voting access decisions. Flipping a critical Cobb County Commission seat to restore a 3-2 Democratic majority and put pro-democracy leadership back in charge of overseeing the County’s Board of Elections — with direct implications for election administration and voter access. Flipping Georgia’s State House District 121, which Donald Trump won by 12 points in 2024. Now we’re one step closer to flipping the State House this year, which requires 10 pickups — fewer than the number Democrats flipped in 2018. Working in a coalition to help add Democratic seats to the Mississippi legislature for the first time in decades and flip nine local seats across strategically selected cities and key jurisdictions — including the election of the first Black mayors of Horn Lake and Brookhaven. The work we did in 2025 positioned Fair Fight to scale in 2026. We’ve tested new tools, deepened partnerships, expanded our reach, and proven we can win even when the odds are stacked against us. We’ve got a proven model. # Iran
* **Death toll from U.S. strike on wedding in Sirik rises to five:** The death toll from a U.S. attack on a wedding party in Sirik rose to five, Iranian state broadcaster IRIB reported on Thursday, after a 22-year-old woman died from her injuries.
* Four of the victims, including a 4-year-old and a 16-year-old, were buried in Kuhestak on Thursday in a funeral attended by a large number of mourners, relatives, military, and civilian officials, according to state media.
* U.S. strikes on Sirik wounded at least 60 people; 11 remain hospitalized and six are in an intensive care unit, according to IRIB.
* **Iranian authorities report intercepting stockpiled weapons on Pakistan border:** Iranian officials claimed they seized a "significant weapons cache" after a clash with militants at the Pakistan border, Iran's Fars news agency reported on Thursday, alleging that the weapons were being smuggled into the country to "carry out acts of sabotage and create insecurity."
* The cache included RPG-7 launchers, antitank RPG projectiles, RPG propellant charges, 2,382 rounds for AK-47 rifles, and 796 rounds for M4 rifles, according to a commander in Iran's border guard.
* **IRGC arrests suspected Kurdish militants carrying munitions near Iraqi border:** Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Thursday that it arrested seven people allegedly carrying ammunition in the country's northwestern Ilam province, claiming the detainees belonged to a Kurdish separatist group and that they sought "to carry out armed operations" against the government.
* **EU to join U.S. economic pressure campaign against Iran, Bessent claims:** U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced in a Thursday evening X post that the European Union had officially joined "Operation Economic Outcast," the U.S.'s economic pressure campaign against Iran, noting that the U.S. "appreciated" the body's "strong and early stance." The EU, however, has yet to announce participation.
* Bessent called the campaign a "clear message" to the Iranian government, and said that the pressure would not cease until Iran's "every remaining financial lifeline" was severed.
* The EU stated earlier that it would "work closely with the United States and other G7 and international partners to maintain pressure on Iran and contribute to de-escalation and regional stability."
* **Vance addresses Iran "conflict" in briefing: **At a White House press briefing, U.S. Vice President JD Vance addressed the U.S.'s ongoing war on Iran, rejecting calls for a timetable, ruling out negotiations, and leaving open the possibility of U.S. covert action.
* Vance [refused](https://substack.com/redirect/6769b7c8-aad8-495e-9571-feccb0f99440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to call the conflict a "war," saying that, at present, "there is no active shooting," while acknowledging recent strikes as part of a "flare-up."
* When asked whether the war would end before the midterms, Vance said he didn't know, but would not "set an artificial timeline."
* He also said that the U.S. was not presently negotiating with Iran, and would not talk to them "unless they stop shooting at commercial shipping."
* Vance said that the U.S. remained open to every means of fighting Iran, including arming dissidents. "Everything that could happen is on the table," he said, including "economic pressure, military pressure, diplomatic pressure, covert pressure."
* Vance also said China was "willing to play ball" with the U.S.'s campaign to isolate Iran, though he noted Beijing was not doing everything Washington had asked of it, and named Turkey, Azerbaijan, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar as countries privately helping apply pressure.
* The campaign was intended, in part, to prevent Iran from rebuilding its nuclear program, Vance [said](https://substack.com/redirect/6769b7c8-aad8-495e-9571-feccb0f99440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but acknowledged: "So far, we haven't seen them try to do so."
* Asked about the U.S. strike on a wedding gathering in Kuhestak, southern Iran, that killed five people and wounded 67, Vance [said](https://substack.com/redirect/6a263fac-af70-413c-9365-c4898232b557?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) he was "extremely skeptical" of the reports that the U.S. had intentionally or knowingly killed civilians. "The United States never targets civilians in combat. We never will do that. We never have done that, and unfortunately, obviously, sometimes things happen," he said.
* **Iranian VP threatens "asymmetrical response" to U.S. attacks: **Mohammed Reza Aref, Iran's first vice president, said in a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/5bd9274d-fc4b-4aa4-83cb-c495fdbec689?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X that the United States had changed Tehran's security and defense calculations, warning Iran's next response would be "asymmetrical" and "multi-layered."
* "The Americans should start thinking about stockpiling gasoline and fuel," Aref warned. "Dark months await the American economy."
* **Netanyahu says Israel remains committed to overthrowing Iran 's government; Katz threatens energy infrastructure: **Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reportedly told senior Israeli officials that overthrowing Iran's leadership is his "next main mission," according to the Israeli newspaper Israel Hayom.
* Separately, Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said that his country would strike Iran's energy and civilian infrastructure if Iran were to attack Israel, saying that such an attack would "free Israel from any existing limitations on attacking Iran."
* "We will cripple all of Iran's national military and civilian infrastructure--including energy infrastructure--and return Iran deep into the Stone Age and darkness," Katz threatened in a Thursday speech.

* **South Korea reviews possible military deployment to Strait of Hormuz:** South Korea is [reviewing](https://substack.com/redirect/462e8be6-c0eb-4cde-bc5c-af7b03103e8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a possible deployment of military assets to the Strait of Hormuz amid pressure from Trump for allies to support operations in the region, The Guardian reported.
* The assets reportedly under consideration include a P-8 Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft, a naval logistics support ship, and an explosive ordnance disposal team. The presidential office, however, said "nothing related to the matter has been decided."
* South Korea relies heavily on the Strait of Hormuz, with more than 90% of its primary energy imported and about 70% of its crude oil passing through the waterway.

* **Trump calls reporters "treasonous SCUM" over reports of low munitions: **In response to recent reporting on the U.S.'s diminishing munitions stockpiles, which some experts have characterized as "dangerously low," Trump [called](https://substack.com/redirect/146438d3-32de-4af9-a6a6-c1026fd69a41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) outlets that reported on the topic "treasonous SCUM" and claimed the reports were inaccurate, saying the U.S. was producing munitions at "levels never seen before" and has "far more than we could ever use."

* **Israeli attacks kill two Palestinians in Gaza on Friday:** One Palestinian was [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/45fd341d-1858-4415-b745-e114b112cb32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and "several others" wounded when an Israeli drone struck a group of people west of Khan Younis, WAFA reported. Another Palestinian was killed and three others wounded by Israeli gunfire north of the city.
* **Israeli forces kill Palestinian in East Jerusalem, shoot and wound children in Bethlehem:**
* **East Jerusalem:** Israeli police [shot and killed](https://substack.com/redirect/d28b12f4-96b5-4269-b2d8-5aaa76c8584a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Ibrahim Al-Hindi, 33, from Beit Hanina, near Damascus Gate early Friday,, according to WAFA. Police reportedly claimed he had attempted to stab an officer. His killing brings the number of Palestinians killed in the Jerusalem governorate this year to 17.
* **Bethlehem** : Two Palestinian children were shot and wounded with live ammunition during an Israeli raid on Beit Fajjar, south of Bethlehem in the occupied West Bank, on Thursday evening.
* **Ramallah:** Settlers [erected](https://substack.com/redirect/95a6563f-3d4a-4dbc-acb5-3556c2dd06a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a tent Friday near Palestinian homes in Umm Safa, northwest of Ramallah, after dozens attacked a resident's home and property under Israeli military protection, WAFA reported. Israeli forces closed the main entrance to Al-Mughayyir, northeast of Ramallah, where two Palestinian teens were killed by Israeli gunfire on Wednesday, preventing residents from entering or leaving, as settlers encroached on Palestinian land east of the village.
* The United Nations [said](https://substack.com/redirect/e2d51d55-e5f2-4af3-8cfd-d28c96504985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the teens' killings brings the number of Palestinians killed by Israeli forces and settlers in the village since December 2024 to nine, including five boys. The UN said Al-Mughayyir, surrounded by eight settlement outposts, has faced "incessant settler and state violence" aimed at forcing Palestinians from the area.
* **Fourth person killed in Nazareth in 24 hours:** A young Palestinian man was shot dead in Nazareth on Thursday, the fourth person killed in the city within 24 hours. His killing brought the number of Palestinian citizens of Israel killed in violent crime this year to 158, amid continued criticism of Israeli police and the government over their failure to investigate most killings and hold those responsible to account.
* Israeli police said they arrested 30 people in two overnight operations on Thursday and Friday, claiming dozens of officers "stormed several compounds belonging to gangs" and, "in several cases," chased and arrested suspects.
* **Israeli prison guards beat Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, injuring his head, face, and chest:** Israeli prison guards repeatedly [beat](https://substack.com/redirect/b442d283-c47e-4fde-b248-f0c47e09a4c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) detained Palestinian doctor Hussam Abu Safiya with hands, feet and batons, the Palestinian Center for Prisoners' Defense said, citing a new message through his lawyer.
* Abu Safiya, director of Gaza's Kamal Adwan Hospital, said guards deprive him of sleep with noise and loudspeakers at night and threaten him against revealing his prison conditions. He also reported being assaulted after lawyers' visits, suggesting retaliation for speaking out.
* The center said he has injuries to his head, face, chest and left eye while being denied medical care and called for urgent UN, Red Cross, and WHO intervention.
* **UN report: Israel violated international law when it expelled Palestinian refugees from three West Bank camps:** A new UN Human Rights [report](https://substack.com/redirect/dc48f98a-7208-4938-a5e3-7b488f38c9dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) says Israeli security forces forcibly displaced the entire Palestinian populations of the Jenin, Nur Shams, and Tulkarm refugee camps in the occupied West Bank in January and February 2025 and are still preventing their return. "Operation Iron Wall" killed civilians, destroyed hundreds of homes, damaged roads and other infrastructure, cut off water and electricity and barred humanitarian access, the report said, as Israeli forces went door to door forcing residents to leave.
* "The way Operation Iron Wall has been conducted suggests its aim was to expel as many Palestinians as possible and to make way for more illegal Israeli settlements, in further violation of international law," said UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Turk.
* **Amnesty: Israel escalates West Bank annexation with first civil land seizures in Area A:** Israel is escalating its annexation of the occupied West Bank by confiscating land in Area A under Palestinian Authority control, according to a [report](https://substack.com/redirect/a243232a-1efb-48b7-abc2-12a59250ed68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Amnesty International. The rights group said the Israeli military issued at least 15 confiscation orders in July covering about 200 dunams (20 hectares) in the Jenin Governorate, across Areas A and C, to connect the planned settlements of Emek Dotan and Noa.
* According to Peace Now, this marks "the first time since the Oslo Accords that military seizure orders have been issued in Area A openly for civil purposes benefiting settlers rather than for ostensible security reasons."
* "These latest confiscation orders from Area A show how Israel is now brazenly expanding its annexation agenda to areas that have been under the control of the Palestinian authorities since the Oslo Accords," Amnesty said.

* **Luxembourg declines to renew authorization for Israel bonds:** Luxembourg's financial regulator did not renew its authorization for Israeli bonds after it expired on Monday, complicating Israel's ability to raise funds from investors across European markets, Anadolu Agency [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/56d30751-e29c-4208-bc93-ccf6f2ce3a6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Israel can still seek approval from another EU member state to continue marketing the bonds in Europe.
* **DRC announces plans to move Israel embassy to Jerusalem:** The Democratic Republic of the Congo [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/508e97d3-9965-43d0-9b09-c89fab7286e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans to move its embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem.
* Israel claims the entire city as its capital, while Palestinians seek occupied East Jerusalem as the capital of a future Palestinian state. The UN Security Council has rejected measures seeking to alter Jerusalem's status and called on countries not to establish diplomatic missions in the city.

# Yemen
* **Al Jazeera: More than 100 killed in Yemen clashes in past 48 hours:** At least 100 fighters have been killed in clashes between Yemen's Ansarallah and Saudi-backed government forces in the past 48 hours, according to Al Jazeera.
* A military official told AFP 24 government fighters were killed near the western coast, while another said 15 were killed in fighting around Taiz. Medical sources in areas controlled by Ansarallah reported at least 42 Ansarallah fighters killed.
* **Yemen 's Saudi-backed forces claim they regained territory: **Heavy clashes are ongoing between Yemeni's Saudi-backed government forces and Ansarallah fighters in Taiz governorate, with government forces claiming they repelled Ansarallah attacks in Maqbanah and Al-Kudhah and regained some territory that had briefly fallen to the group, Al Jazeera reported.
* Ansarallah has been pushing west of Taiz towards the road linking the city with the Red Sea port of Al-Makha, in an apparent attempt to cut supply routes to government forces there.

* **Israeli forces carry out explosions and shell southern Lebanon despite "ceasefire": **Israeli forces [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/e8a80223-9bfc-4f1a-bd1e-d089e2534914?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explosions in Al-Mansouri in the Tyre (Sour) governorate on Friday, Lebanon's National News Agency reported, while Israeli artillery shelling [sparked fires](https://substack.com/redirect/81d0710b-4fc1-4102-bcb6-3deddfb5e69d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Zawtar Al-Sharqiyah, in the Nabatieh governorate.
* **Israel claims control of Ali Taher Ridge as Katz vows to remain in southern Lebanon until Hezbollah disarms:** The Israeli military [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/4aa6afc7-5e06-4731-8a0b-351f261989d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it had taken control of the Ali Taher Ridge near Nabatieh and cleared two major tunnel routes it described as a Hezbollah "nerve center," The Times of Israel reported.
* Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz [said](https://substack.com/redirect/e2dd17d2-90b6-4087-be85-0f3304f58cba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the operation marked "the completion of the phase of establishing control over the security zone in southern Lebanon," and vowed Israel "will not withdraw" until Hezbollah is disarmed.

* **Israel releases five Lebanese detainees as ICRC calls for better access:** Israel released five Lebanese detainees since Thursday, including four handed over at the Ras Al-Naqoura crossing on Friday. The ICRC transferred the four to a Lebanese army barracks in Tyre (Sour). Among those released was a man who had been detained for more than two months.
* Lebanese President Joseph Aoun [thanked](https://substack.com/redirect/c84b823b-fb42-4cf0-abae-68250d6f3a82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the U.S., President Donald Trump, and international parties, particularly the ICRC, for efforts leading to what he called the release of the "first batch" of Lebanese detainees.
* Dozens of Lebanese citizens are reportedly being detained in Israeli jails. The ICRC [said](https://substack.com/redirect/eed80a85-8c6b-4fc2-beef-51736e988614?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it has been unable to access detainees in Israeli detention facilities since October 2023, including Lebanese nationals, and reiterated its demand for access to them.

# U.S. News
* **House GOP cancels final two weeks of pre-election session** : Republican leaders [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/01325d11-a10e-4ac3-88a1-d8b3fc664624?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the House will cancel its final two pre-election weeks of legislative business, meaning members will leave Washington by September 17 and not return until mid-November.
* Speaker **Mike Johnson** attributed the shortened calendar to a Senate backlog of nearly 600 House-passed bills, and to pre-midterm political pressures, arguing "many [members] want and need to be in their districts, working with their constituents, and running their campaigns."
* GOP leaders indicated they would recall members to Washington only if the Senate advances a party-line budget reconciliation package, which is not currently expected.
* **U.S. shifts to weekly deportation flights to Haiti as violence worsens** : The U.S. government [deported](https://substack.com/redirect/164dd7eb-fb1b-4748-b087-18716a8812db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than 100 people to Haiti on Thursday, landing in Cap-Haitien, the third such flight in three weeks.
* The U.S. has sent deportees from a Louisiana facility to Cap-Haitien rather than to the country's capital, Port-au-Prince, because of gang violence. Gangs control an estimated 70% of the city.
* Violence in the country displaced nearly 1.5 million people nationwide and killed more than 3,050 from January to June, according to the U.N.
* **Missouri Supreme Court blocks congressional map in rare setback for GOP redistricting** : The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously [blocked](https://substack.com/redirect/00893a7d-cf9f-4e4e-94db-6c3eb588ce44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the state's new, Trump-backed congressional maps from being used in November and ordered a statewide referendum on redistricting, following a petition campaign which garnered 30,000 signatures.
* The map that the court jettisoned was used in the state's August primaries. Republicans hoped that map would help them net an additional House seat, with Democratic Rep. **Emanuel Cleaver 's** Kansas City-based district dramatically redrawn.
* **Trump administration proposes IRS rules revoking tax-exempt status from schools with race-based support programs:** The Treasury Department [published](https://substack.com/redirect/0e19ed04-f81c-4911-8465-6aa0a9619244?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) proposed regulations Thursday that would strip tax-exempt status from any school, including universities, found by the IRS to have admissions, scholarship, or other policies deemed racially "discriminatory" toward white or Asian American students.
* The policy, which could apply to as many as 18,000 schools, relies upon a 1983 Supreme Court case which allows the IRS to revoke tax-exempt status from organizations in opposition to "fundamental public policy." It also follows the Supreme Court's 2023 ruling in the Students for Fair Admissions case.
* American Association of University Professors President **Todd Wolfson** called the move "blatantly racist political coercion" and said the group is likely to sue.
* **Florida bans undocumented students from state universities:** Florida's Board of Governors [voted](https://substack.com/redirect/158d00af-4165-4556-b7f2-355f44471bd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unanimously to bar undocumented students from enrolling in state universities starting in the 2027-28 academic year, making Florida the largest state to enact such a ban and joining Alabama, Georgia, and South Carolina, the South Florida Sun-Sentinel reported.
* The vote follows a June decision by the State Board of Education banning undocumented immigrants from Florida's 28 state colleges and adult education programs, and comes after the state already ended in-state tuition waivers for these students.
* At least 4,672 undocumented students were enrolled in state colleges in 2024-25, with an estimated 2,000 more at state universities.
* **U.S. House passes bill that would penalize universities for boycotting Israel:** The House of Representatives passed a bill on Thursday that would bar federal funds from American universities that boycott Israel or its academic institutions, including those located in the occupied West Bank.
* The body approved the measure in a 237-169 vote on Thursday, with 33 Democrats, including **Jake Auchincloss** , **Gil Cisneros** , **Jared Moskowitz** , **Jimmy Pannetta** , **Debbie Wasserman Schultz** , and **Juan Vargas** ,**** joining the Republican majority.
* Republicans **Warren Davidson** and **Thomas Massie** broke ranks with their party to reject the bill. The bill needs the approval of the Republican-controlled Senate and the signature of the president to become law.
* **Trump names Adam Telle acting Army secretary after Driscoll 's resignation: **President Donald Trump [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/ee36cd68-3919-454a-b9fa-664f9261e885?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday evening that **Adam Telle** , currently assistant secretary of the Army for Civil Works, would become acting Army secretary "effective immediately."
* The appointment follows the resignation of **Dan Driscoll** , whose departure this week capped months of internal clashes with War Secretary **Pete Hegseth** over his broader push to reshape Army leadership.
* Telle previously served as Sen. **Bill Hagerty 's** chief of staff and worked in the White House Office of Legislative Affairs during Trump's first term.
* **Missouri GOP candidate charged with plotting to plant drugs on political opponent:** The Justice Department [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/6d007a57-0d6e-4850-9502-3d3bbcc2a0ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) charges against **Thomas Ross** , 37, a Republican candidate for Missouri state representative, alleging he instructed his former campaign manager to plant cocaine and Adderall on his primary opponent,**Louise Secker** , whom he defeated by just 33 votes last month. The head of the Missouri GOP has called for Ross to drop out of the race.

# Other International News
* **Global food prices hit four-year high, UN says:** The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's Food Price Index [climbed](https://substack.com/redirect/5ab165d4-cdff-4c76-b8bc-3393db0339eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for a third straight month to 133.3 points in August, its highest level since late 2022, with every tracked category--cereals, vegetable oils, sugar, meat, and dairy--rising over the month.
* FAO chief economist Maximo Torero said "climate shocks, geopolitical tensions and disrupted trade logistics are converging to tighten supply expectations," with sugar rising fastest, up nearly 12% to a one-year high.
* Cereal prices climbed more than 2% to a two-year high, a result of strikes in the Black Sea, a major route for Russian grain exporters.
* The risks are compounded by global warming and the return of El Niño, which contributed to reduced crop yields amid European heatwaves this summer. The weather pattern also threatens production across Asia, with the World Food Programme warning the phenomenon could push another 50 million people into acute hunger by the end of next year.
* **U.S. sanctions Ra ul Castro's grandson, five Cuban companies amid economic pressure campaign**: The U.S. State Department [imposed](https://substack.com/redirect/9fe9ae81-9b73-4bd7-9fb9-efb592d64cdc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) new sanctions on five Cuban companies and Fidel Ernesto Castro, the 31-year-old grandson of 95-year-old revolutionary leader Raul Castro.
* Washington sanctioned the state-owned Banco Exterior de Cuba, two nickel mining companies, and two energy-sector firms including an oil importer, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio accusing Cuban leaders of enriching themselves while seeking "to export subversive Marxist ideology to the United States."
* Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez countered that "Cuba does not threaten U.S. national security or the U.S. economy." "The accusation that Cuba allegedly sponsors terrorism actually reveals the U.S. government's lack of seriousness," he added.
* A U.S. oil blockade imposed earlier this year has worsened Cuba's power grid failures and prompted UN warnings of a humanitarian crisis on the island.
* **Cuba unveils new market reforms to attract foreign investment amid U.S.-driven crisis:** Cuba [published](https://substack.com/redirect/d5e232c9-99b9-41bf-9799-2e9877f33776?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 34 pages of new regulations Thursday aimed at attracting foreign investment, trade, and tourism, part of ongoing free-market reforms adopted under pressure from Washington and a deepening economic crisis driven by punishing U.S. sanctions.
* The regulations follow a package of 176 reforms announced in June, widely considered the largest overhaul of Cuba's socialist economic model since the 1959 revolution.
* **Ukrainian security service and military clash in Kyiv:** Ukraine's security service and military intelligence agency [exchanged](https://substack.com/redirect/18854d38-49ae-4fd1-909b-381fe1f907b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) gunfire in Kyiv on Wednesday, reportedly wounding three officers.
* The clash between the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) and Defence Intelligence of the Ministry of Defence of Ukraine (GUR) broke out the night of September 2 over the detention of Stepan Kaplunov, deputy commander of the Russian Volunteer Corps, an anti-Kremlin Russian unit fighting for Ukraine under military intelligence.
* The SBU said its officers came under armed attack while investigating a Russian assassination plot. A GUR commander accused SBU personnel of opening fire on unarmed intelligence officers without warning.
* President Volodymyr Zelenskyy ordered an investigation and dismissed senior SBU official Oleh Khramov. "Here in Ukraine, shooting is only permissible at Russian occupiers," he said.

* **Russian drone strikes Kyiv headquarters:** A Russian drone [hit](https://substack.com/redirect/6b383d7a-8dcc-4de6-a0fb-4fbabe820b97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the headquarters of Ukraine's security service, on Volodymyrska Street across from St. Sophia Cathedral, injuring at least five people, according to Ukrainian officials. Zelenskyy said the drone was aimed directly at the office of SBU chief Oleksandr Poklad, but did not disclose whether he was present.
* Zelenskyy ordered the SBU to prepare "an appropriate, tangible response" against Russia, saying the retaliation should, where possible, mirror the strike and would receive support from Ukraine's military.
* **UAE pardons imprisoned dissident Abdulrahman Al-Qaradawi:** The president of the United Arab Emirates has pardoned Egyptian-Turkish poet and political dissident Abdulrahman Yusuf Al-Qaradawi one week after he was sentenced to 10 years in prison and a fine of AED200,000 ($54,452), [according](https://substack.com/redirect/6b0ca0fe-a8c4-44c8-82e8-e63ad9d2b4ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to The National.
* Qaradawi was first detained in Lebanon in December 2024 on charges related to a video he posted to social media while visiting Syria in which he criticized the governments of Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Both Egypt and the UAE issued extradition requests for Qaradawi and he was deported to Abu Dhabi less than two weeks later and remained forcibly disappeared for over 200 days in what human rights groups called a flagrant violation of human rights and due process. Read Drop Site's coverage of Qaradawi's case **[here](https://substack.com/redirect/17e130b0-e1ea-478b-832f-1e80a902209b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* **Haitian FM urges UN to renew international force mandate:** Haiti's Foreign Minister Raina Forbin [urged](https://substack.com/redirect/cb6d7a1c-2d6a-4664-84be-443cfa8917c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the UN Security Council Thursday to extend the 12-month mandate of an international force supporting Haitian police "as soon as possible" before it expires this month, saying stronger backing is essential for the country to hold its first election since 2016.
* **Court orders arrest of Philippines VP Sara Duterte over alleged assassination threat:** A Quezon City court [issued](https://substack.com/redirect/a9ac8297-b9c7-4e6f-af03-2dcba2d0307d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a warrant Friday for the arrest of Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte over allegations she arranged to have President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., his wife, and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez killed.
* Duterte is facing an ongoing Senate impeachment trial over the same threats--a case that, if it results in a guilty verdict, would remove her from office and quash her 2028 presidential ambitions.
* Duterte's lawyer, Paul Lawrence Lim, said she has "no intention of evading the law," and officials expect her to post bail quickly rather than face detention.
* Her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, remains in International Criminal Court custody in The Hague awaiting trial over his deadly anti-drug campaign.
